quote: The abundance of Shigella, Acinetobacter and Cupriavidus was significantly decreased compared with the CY group.
statement: 与对照组（CY组）相比，实验组的Shigella、Acinetobacter和Cupriavidus的丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组（CY组）相比，实验组的Shigella、Acinetobacter和Cupriavidus的丰度显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group (CY group), the abundance of Shigella, Acinetobacter, and Cupriavidus in the experimental group was significantly reduced.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: The NMDS of bacterial community structures is shown in Fig. 6 . The CY group was separated from the other 3 groups of samples, while the samples from groups Y1, Y2, and Y3 were cross-clustered with each other.
statement: 非度量多维标度分析显示，对照组样本与其他三个实验组样本分离，而Y1、Y2和Y3组的样本相互交叉聚类。
text_zh: 非度量多维标度分析显示，对照组样本与其他三个实验组样本分离，而Y1、Y2和Y3组的样本相互交叉聚类。
text_en: Non-metric multidimensional scaling analysis showed that the control group samples were separated from the other three experimental group samples, while the samples of groups Y1, Y2 and Y3 clustered together with overlapping.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: After finishing the feeding experiment, 20 experimental fish from each cage were randomly chosen and injected intraperitoneally with 1 mL of bacterial suspension per 100 g fish.
statement: 在饲养实验结束后，从每个网箱中随机选取20条实验鱼，按每100克鱼注射1毫升细菌悬浮液进行腹腔注射。
text_zh: 在饲养实验结束后，从每个网箱中随机选取20条实验鱼，按每100克鱼注射1毫升细菌悬浮液进行腹腔注射。
text_en: After the feeding experiment ended, 20 experimental fish were randomly selected from each net cage and injected intraperitoneally with bacterial suspension at a dose of 1 mL per 100 g of fish.

quote: The injected concentration of bacteria was approximately 4 × 10 7 CFU/mL, based on a previous challenge test.
statement: 根据之前的攻毒试验，注射的细菌浓度约为4×10^7 CFU/mL。
text_zh: 根据之前的攻毒试验，注射的细菌浓度约为4×10^7 CFU/mL。
text_en: Based on previous challenge tests, the injected bacterial concentration was about 4×10^7 CFU/mL.

quote: Then, the injected fish were returned to the same cage for 7-d observation.
statement: 随后，将注射后的鱼放回同一网箱观察7天。
text_zh: 随后，将注射后的鱼放回同一网箱观察7天。
text_en: Subsequently, the injected fish were returned to the same net cage for a 7-day observation period.

quote: The dead fish were recorded each day and the total mortality rate was calculated as follows: mortality rate (%) = 100 × numbers of dead fish/numbers of inoculated fish.
statement: 每天记录死亡鱼类，并按公式计算总死亡率：死亡率(%) = 100 × 死亡鱼数 / 接种鱼数。
text_zh: 每天记录死亡鱼类，并按公式计算总死亡率：死亡率(%) = 100 × 死亡鱼数 / 接种鱼数。
text_en: Dead fish were recorded daily, and the total mortality rate was calculated using the formula: Mortality (%) = 100 × Number of dead fish / Number of challenged fish.

quote: One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) was performed to test the effect of dietary B. subtilis.
statement: 采用单因素方差分析（ANOVA）来检验日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌的效果。
text_zh: 采用单因素方差分析（ANOVA）来检验日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌的效果。
text_en: One-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) was used to test the effect of Bacillus subtilis in the diet.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: The mortality rate in the Y1, Y2 and Y3 groups decreased significantly compared with that in the CY group.
statement: 与对照组相比，Y1、Y2和Y3组的死亡率显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，Y1、Y2和Y3组的死亡率显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, mortality was significantly reduced in groups Y1, Y2, and Y3.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: In the present study, dietary supplementation of B. subtilis 1-C-7 had no significant effect on the growth of Chinese perch at the concentration of 0.85 × 10 8 CFU/kg and 0.95 × 10 9 CFU/kg.
statement: 在本研究中，在0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg和0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg浓度下，日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7对鳜鱼生长无显著影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，在0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg和0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg浓度下，日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7对鳜鱼生长无显著影响。
text_en: In this study, dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 at concentrations of 0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg and 0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg had no significant effect on the growth of mandarin fish.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: However, B. subtilis 1-C-7 overdose inhibited the growth of Chinese perch, as the excessive addition of B. subtilis caused a significant increase in amylase activity, which was presumed to be caused by the amylase secreted by the exogenous B. subtilis .
statement: 然而，枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7过量抑制了鳜鱼的生长，因为过量添加枯草芽孢杆菌导致淀粉酶活性显著增加，这被推测是由外源枯草芽孢杆菌分泌的淀粉酶引起的。
text_zh: 然而，枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7过量抑制了鳜鱼的生长，因为过量添加枯草芽孢杆菌导致淀粉酶活性显著增加，这被推测是由外源枯草芽孢杆菌分泌的淀粉酶引起的。
text_en: However, Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 at an excessive level inhibited the growth of mandarin fish, because excessive addition of Bacillus subtilis led to a significant increase in amylase activity, which was speculated to be caused by amylase secreted by exogenous Bacillus subtilis.

quote: The fish fed the diet without B. subtilis 1-C-7 had the highest value of MDA, while the fish in the Y2 group had the lowest value of MDA among the 4 groups.
statement: 饲喂不含枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7日粮的鱼MDA值最高，而Y2组鱼的MDA值在4组中最低。
text_zh: 饲喂不含枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7日粮的鱼MDA值最高，而Y2组鱼的MDA值在4组中最低。
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: Furthermore, the value of MDA in the Y3 group was markedly higher than that in the Y2 group.
statement: 此外，Y3组的MDA值显著高于Y2组。
text_zh: 此外，Y3组的MDA值显著高于Y2组。
text_en: In addition, the MDA values in the Y3 group were significantly higher than those in the Y2 group.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7
counterevidence: 高剂量（Y3）的MDA水平回升，表明存在剂量效应或最佳添加量。

quote: The ALP activity in the liver was elevated with the increasing of dietary B. subtilis 1-C-7 supplementation.
statement: 肝脏中的ALP活性随着日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7添加量的增加而升高。
text_zh: 肝脏中的ALP活性随着日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7添加量的增加而升高。
text_en: ALP activity in the liver increased with increasing dietary supplementation levels of Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: The activity of lysozyme in the liver was not affected by dietary B. subtilis 1-C-7 supplementation.
statement: 肝脏中的溶菌酶活性不受日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7添加的影响。
text_zh: 肝脏中的溶菌酶活性不受日粮中枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7添加的影响。
text_en: Lysozyme activity in the liver was not affected by dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: These results suggested that in Chinese perch, dietary supplementation of 0.85 × 10 8 CFU/kg B. subtilis 1-C-7 could improve the intestinal bacterial community structure, but dietary supplementation of 0.91 × 10 10 CFU/kg B. subtilis 1-C-7 might be harmful to intestinal microbiota.
statement: 在鳜鱼中，日粮补充0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可改善肠道菌群结构，但补充0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg可能对肠道微生物群有害。
text_zh: 在鳜鱼中，日粮补充0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可改善肠道菌群结构，但补充0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg可能对肠道微生物群有害。
text_en: In mandarin fish, dietary supplementation with 0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 can improve the gut microbiota structure, but supplementation with 0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg may be harmful to the gut microbiota.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7
counterevidence: 高剂量（0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg）可能对肠道微生物群有害

quote: In conclusion, dietary supplementation of B. subtilis 1-C-7 improved the intestinal microbiota, intestinal health and A. hydrophila disease resistance of Chinese perch.
statement: 总之，日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7改善了鳜鱼的肠道微生物群、肠道健康和嗜水气单胞菌疾病抵抗力。
text_zh: 总之，日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7改善了鳜鱼的肠道微生物群、肠道健康和嗜水气单胞菌疾病抵抗力。
text_en: In conclusion, dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 improved the gut microbiota, gut health, and resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila disease in mandarin fish.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: OTU richness (Species and Chao), and diversity index (Shannon and Simpson) for 16S rRNA libraries of mid-gut in mandarin fish fed with test diets.
statement: The study measured OTU richness and diversity indices of the mid-gut microbiome in mandarin fish fed with test diets.
text_en: The study measured OTU richness and diversity indices of the mid-gut microbiome in mandarin fish fed with test diets.

statement: The control group (CY) had significantly higher Shannon diversity index compared to the groups supplemented with B. subtilis (Y1, Y2, Y3).
text_en: The control group (CY) had significantly higher Shannon diversity index compared to the groups supplemented with B. subtilis (Y1, Y2, Y3).
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: The Y1, Y2 and Y3 groups showed higher abundances of Tenericutes and lower abundances of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes compared to the CY group
statement: Supplementation with B. subtilis resulted in higher abundance of Tenericutes and lower abundance of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes compared to the control group.
text_en: Supplementation with B. subtilis resulted in higher abundance of Tenericutes and lower abundance of Proteobacteria and Firmicutes compared to the control group.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: the highest abundance of Bacteroidetes was found in the Y2 group
statement: The Y2 group (supplemented with 0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg B. subtilis) had the highest abundance of Bacteroidetes.
text_en: The Y2 group (supplemented with 0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg B. subtilis) had the highest abundance of Bacteroidetes.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: In the high-density intensive aquaculture water body, the pollution sources are not only the external inputs such as industrial wastewater and agricultural surface resources pollution, but also the endogenous inputs such as residual bait, metabolites, and medicines.
statement: 高密度集约化养殖水体中的污染源包括工业废水、农业面源污染等外部输入，以及残饵、代谢物和药物等内部输入。
text_zh: 高密度集约化养殖水体中的污染源包括工业废水、农业面源污染等外部输入，以及残饵、代谢物和药物等内部输入。
text_en: Pollution sources in high-density intensive aquaculture water bodies include external inputs such as industrial wastewater and agricultural non-point source pollution, as well as internal inputs such as residual feed, metabolites, and drugs.

quote: These sources lead to illness and even death of farmed animals, thereby seriously affecting the water quality and safety of the aquatic products.
statement: 上述污染源导致养殖动物生病甚至死亡，并严重影响水产品质量和水产品安全。
text_zh: 上述污染源导致养殖动物生病甚至死亡，并严重影响水产品质量和水产品安全。
text_en: The aforementioned pollution sources cause farmed aquatic animals to become sick or even die, and seriously affect the quality and safety of aquatic products.

quote: With the aggravation of water pollution, the diseases of cultured fish are becoming more and more serious.
statement: 随着水污染的加剧，养殖鱼类的疾病变得越来越严重。
text_zh: 随着水污染的加剧，养殖鱼类的疾病变得越来越严重。
text_en: As water pollution intensifies, diseases in farmed fish are becoming increasingly severe.

quote: In the fish, the disease manifests with slow swimming, slow response to external stimuli, dyspnea, and loss of appetite.
statement: 患病鱼表现为游动缓慢、对外界刺激反应迟钝、呼吸困难和食欲减退。
text_zh: 患病鱼表现为游动缓慢、对外界刺激反应迟钝、呼吸困难和食欲减退。
text_en: Diseased fish exhibit slow swimming, dull response to external stimuli, difficulty breathing, and reduced appetite.

quote: Increased amylase activity may improve the digestibility of starch in mandarin fish, leading to an increase in the level of digestible carbohydrates, resulting in liver injury and decreased growth performance.
statement: 增加的淀粉酶活性可能提高鳜鱼中淀粉的消化率，导致可消化碳水化合物水平升高，从而引起肝损伤和生长性能下降。
text_zh: 增加的淀粉酶活性可能提高鳜鱼中淀粉的消化率，导致可消化碳水化合物水平升高，从而引起肝损伤和生长性能下降。
text_en: Increased amylase activity may improve starch digestibility in mandarin fish, leading to elevated levels of digestible carbohydrates, thereby causing liver damage and reduced growth performance.
intervention_record: 高淀粉酶活性/高碳水消化

quote: Adequate dietary supplementation of B. subtilis can improve disease resistance and antioxidant capacity of aquatic animals ( Taoka et al., 2006 ; Aly et al., 2008 ), and this conclusion is also supported by the decrease of the mortality rate in the challenge test.
statement: 适量的日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌可以改善水生动物的抗病力和抗氧化能力，这一结论也得到攻毒试验中死亡率降低的支持。
text_zh: 适量的日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌可以改善水生动物的抗病力和抗氧化能力，这一结论也得到攻毒试验中死亡率降低的支持。
text_en: Appropriate dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis can improve the disease resistance and antioxidant capacity of aquatic animals, a conclusion also supported by reduced mortality in challenge tests.
intervention_record: 适量添加枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: A similar unpublished study conducted by our lab indicated that dietary host B. subtilis could enhance the secretion of antibacterial substances, such as aromatic amino acids and their derivatives, and reduce the proliferation of challenge bacteria in the intestine of tilapias and thus increase the survival rate of tilapia after infection with Streptococcus agalactiae .
statement: 我们实验室进行的一项类似的未发表研究表明，日粮中的宿主枯草芽孢杆菌可以增强抗菌物质（如芳香族氨基酸及其衍生物）的分泌，减少罗非鱼肠道内攻毒细菌的增殖，从而提高罗非鱼感染无乳链球菌后的存活率。
text_zh: 我们实验室进行的一项类似的未发表研究表明，日粮中的宿主枯草芽孢杆菌可以增强抗菌物质（如芳香族氨基酸及其衍生物）的分泌，减少罗非鱼肠道内攻毒细菌的增殖，从而提高罗非鱼感染无乳链球菌后的存活率。
text_en: A similar unpublished study conducted in our laboratory showed that host Bacillus subtilis in the diet can enhance the secretion of antimicrobial substances (such as aromatic amino acids and their derivatives), reduce the proliferation of challenge bacteria in the intestines of tilapia, thereby improving the survival rate of tilapia after infection with Streptococcus agalactiae.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: The increase of survival of mandarin fish after challenge with A. hydrophila may also be attributed to the secretion of antimicrobial substances by B. subtilis .
statement: 鳜鱼在受嗜水气单胞菌攻击后存活率的提高也可能归因于枯草芽孢杆菌分泌的抗菌物质。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在受嗜水气单胞菌攻击后存活率的提高也可能归因于枯草芽孢杆菌分泌的抗菌物质。
text_en: The increased survival rate of mandarin fish after attack by Aeromonas hydrophila may also be attributed to antimicrobial substances secreted by Bacillus subtilis.
intervention_record: 枯草芽孢杆菌分泌抗菌物质

quote: MDA is known to indicate the lipid peroxidation rate or reflect tissue peroxidation damage; the decrease in MDA content may suggest that dietary B. subtilis supplementation could improve the antioxidant capacity of Chinese perch.
statement: MDA已知指示脂质过氧化速率或反映组织过氧化损伤；MDA含量的降低可能表明日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌可以提高鳜鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: MDA已知指示脂质过氧化速率或反映组织过氧化损伤；MDA含量的降低可能表明日粮补充枯草芽孢杆菌可以提高鳜鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_en: MDA is known to indicate the rate of lipid peroxidation or reflect tissue peroxidative damage; a decrease in MDA content may suggest that dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis can improve the antioxidant capacity of mandarin fish.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: The animals were continuously oxygenated and observed for 7 days, and the morbidity and mortality were recorded.
statement: 实验动物在连续充氧条件下观察7天，并记录发病率和死亡率。
text_zh: 实验动物在连续充氧条件下观察7天，并记录发病率和死亡率。
text_en: The experimental animals were observed for 7 days under continuous aeration, and morbidity and mortality rates were recorded.

quote: The water used for breeding was deflated 1 day ahead of time, and the water was changed at regular intervals every day.
statement: 用于繁殖的水提前1天静置（除氯/沉淀），并且每天定期换水。
text_zh: 用于繁殖的水提前1天静置（除氯/沉淀），并且每天定期换水。
text_en: Water used for breeding is allowed to stand for 1 day in advance (dechlorination/precipitation), and water is regularly changed daily.

quote: In this study, fish fed the Y2 and Y3 diets had higher AST and ALT activities than fish in the other groups.
statement: 在本研究中，喂食Y2和Y3饲料的鱼其AST和ALT活性高于其他组的鱼。
text_zh: 在本研究中，喂食Y2和Y3饲料的鱼其AST和ALT活性高于其他组的鱼。
text_en: In this study, fish fed Y2 and Y3 diets had higher AST and ALT activities than fish in other groups.

quote: These results further evidence that a relatively high dose of B. subtilis 1-C-7 may suppress fish growth performance and health.
statement: 这些结果进一步证明，相对高剂量的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可能会抑制鱼类的生长性能和健康。
text_zh: 这些结果进一步证明，相对高剂量的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可能会抑制鱼类的生长性能和健康。
text_en: These results further demonstrate that a relatively high dose of Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 may inhibit the growth performance and health of fish.

quote: When ingested, B. subtilis secretes large amounts of amylase and lipase, thus reducing the pressure on liver lipid metabolism which may decrease inflammation of the liver.
statement: 摄入后，枯草芽孢杆菌分泌大量淀粉酶和脂肪酶，从而减轻肝脏脂质代谢的压力，这可能减少肝脏炎症。
text_zh: 摄入后，枯草芽孢杆菌分泌大量淀粉酶和脂肪酶，从而减轻肝脏脂质代谢的压力，这可能减少肝脏炎症。
text_en: After ingestion, Bacillus subtilis secretes large amounts of amylase and lipase, thereby reducing the pressure on hepatic lipid metabolism, which may reduce liver inflammation.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌

quote: These results suggested that dietary supplementation of 0.85 × 10 8 CFU/kg B. subtilis 1-C-7 could improve disease resistance and intestinal health in Chinese perch, but dietary supplementation of 0.95 × 10 9 CFU/kg and 0.91 × 10 10 CFU/kg B. subtilis 1-C-7 might be harmful to health.
statement: 结果表明，日粮补充0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可以改善鳜鱼的抗病力和肠道健康，但补充0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg和0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可能对健康有害。
text_zh: 结果表明，日粮补充0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可以改善鳜鱼的抗病力和肠道健康，但补充0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg和0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg的枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7可能对健康有害。
text_en: The results showed that dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 at 0.85 × 10^8 CFU/kg could improve the disease resistance and gut health of mandarin fish, but supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 at 0.95 × 10^9 CFU/kg and 0.91 × 10^10 CFU/kg may be harmful to health.
intervention_record: 不同剂量枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7
outcome: 抗病力、肠道健康及整体健康

quote: Antimicrobial susceptibility test of 30 antimicrobial agents (purchased from Hangzhou Tianhe Microbial Reagent Co., Ltd.) was performed, the size of the antimicrobial circle was measured, and the results of the antimicrobial susceptibility test were recorded
statement: 对30种抗菌药物进行了药敏试验，测量了抑菌圈大小并记录了结果。
text_zh: 对30种抗菌药物进行了药敏试验，测量了抑菌圈大小并记录了结果。
text_en: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing was performed on 30 antimicrobial agents, measuring the zone of inhibition sizes and recording the results.

quote: When the disease is serious, the fish swims alone and does not eat.
statement: When the disease is severe, the fish swims alone and stops eating.
text_en: When the disease is severe, the fish swims alone and stops eating.

quote: The gill line decays with sludge, especially at the end of the gill line.
statement: The gill filaments decay accompanied by sludge, particularly at the ends.
text_en: The gill filaments decay accompanied by sludge, particularly at the ends.

quote: There is a lot of mucus, which often sticks to sludge and debris.
statement: There is excessive mucus production that adheres to sludge and debris.
text_en: There is excessive mucus production that adheres to sludge and debris.

quote: The inner epidermis of the operculum is often congested.
statement: The inner skin of the gill cover is frequently congested.
text_en: The inner skin of the gill cover is frequently congested.

quote: After 7 days of observation, no disease was found in S. chuatsi injected with the bacteria and saline, which indicated that the strain was not pathogenic to S. chuatsi or did not cause the disease alone.
statement: 在注射细菌和生理盐水后观察7天，未发现在鳜鱼中出现疾病，这表明该菌株对鳜鱼无致病性或单独不引起疾病。
text_zh: 在注射细菌和生理盐水后观察7天，未发现在鳜鱼中出现疾病，这表明该菌株对鳜鱼无致病性或单独不引起疾病。
text_en: After observing for 7 days following injection of bacteria and saline, no disease was found in Siniperca chuatsi, indicating that this strain is non-pathogenic to Siniperca chuatsi or does not cause disease alone.

quote: The animals were fed in 34 × 21 × 25 cm glass tank.
statement: 实验动物饲养在尺寸为34×21×25厘米的玻璃缸中。
text_zh: 实验动物饲养在尺寸为34×21×25厘米的玻璃缸中。
text_en: The experimental animals were kept in glass tanks measuring 34×21×25 cm.

quote: The susceptibility test of 30 antimicrobial agents in common use in farm was carried out, and the results showed that the bacterium was sensitive to piperacillin, carbenicillin, cefoperazone, cefazolin, ofloxacin, gentamicin, kanamycin, amikacin, neomycin, erythromycin, minocycline, doxycycline, chloramphenicol, and polymyxin b; and resistant to penicillin, ampicillin, oxacillin, ceftriaxone, cefradine, cefalexin, cefuroxime, ceftazidime, ciprofloxacin, norfloxacin, vancomycin, trimethoprim/sulfamethoxazole, clindamycin, midecamycin, tetracycline, and furazolidone
statement: 对农场常用的30种抗菌药物进行敏感性试验，结果显示该细菌对哌拉西林、羧苄西林等14种药物敏感，而对青霉素、氨苄西林等16种药物耐药。
text_zh: 对农场常用的30种抗菌药物进行敏感性试验，结果显示该细菌对哌拉西林、羧苄西林等14种药物敏感，而对青霉素、氨苄西林等16种药物耐药。
text_en: Susceptibility testing was performed on 30 antimicrobial drugs commonly used in farms. The results showed that the bacterium was susceptible to 14 drugs, including piperacillin and carbenicillin, but resistant to 16 drugs, including penicillin and ampicillin.

quote: In this study, dietary B. subtilis 1-C-7 supplementation (Y1, Y2 and Y3) increased the abundance of Tenericutes, and reduced the abundance of pernicious bacteria such as Proteobacteria , Actinobacteria , Thermophilia and Spirochaetes .
statement: 本研究中，日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7（Y1、Y2和Y3组）增加了柔膜菌门的丰度，并降低了变形菌门、放线菌门、嗜热菌属和螺旋体等有害细菌的丰度。
text_zh: 本研究中，日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7（Y1、Y2和Y3组）增加了柔膜菌门的丰度，并降低了变形菌门、放线菌门、嗜热菌属和螺旋体等有害细菌的丰度。
text_en: In this study, dietary supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 (Y1, Y2 and Y3 groups) increased the abundance of Tenericutes and decreased the abundance of harmful bacteria such as Proteobacteria, Actinobacteria, Thermus, and Spirochaetes.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: In addition, the increase of abundance of Mycoplasma and decrease of abundance of Shigella and Anoxybacillus in the present study might indicate an improvement in health status and prevention of some intestinal diseases ( Bozzi et al., 2021 ).
statement: 此外，本研究中支原体丰度的增加以及志贺氏菌和无氧杆菌丰度的减少可能表明健康状况的改善和一些肠道疾病的预防。
text_zh: 此外，本研究中支原体丰度的增加以及志贺氏菌和无氧杆菌丰度的减少可能表明健康状况的改善和一些肠道疾病的预防。
text_en: In addition, the increase in Mycoplasma abundance and the decrease in Shigella and Anaerobacterium abundance in this study may indicate improved health status and prevention of some intestinal diseases.
intervention_record: 日粮添加枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7

quote: However, excessive supplementation of B. subtilis 1-C-7 (Y3) increased the abundance of common pathogenic bacteria such as Pseudomonas , indicating a diminution of beneficial effects or a deleterious effect of dietary B. subtilis 1-C-7, thus potentially damaging the intestinal environment and inhibiting growth.
statement: 然而，过量补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7（Y3组）增加了假单胞菌等常见致病菌的丰度，表明有益效果减弱或产生有害影响，从而可能破坏肠道环境并抑制生长。
text_zh: 然而，过量补充枯草芽孢杆菌1-C-7（Y3组）增加了假单胞菌等常见致病菌的丰度，表明有益效果减弱或产生有害影响，从而可能破坏肠道环境并抑制生长。
text_en: However, excessive supplementation with Bacillus subtilis 1-C-7 (Y3 group) increased the abundance of common pathogens such as Pseudomonas, indicating reduced beneficial effects or harmful impacts, which may disrupt the gut environment and inhibit growth.

quote: Therefore, real-time monitoring of the drug resistance and its change in trend in the bacteria isolated from fish breeding sites should be periodically performed.
statement: 因此，应定期对鱼类养殖场所分离出的细菌进行耐药性及其变化趋势的实时监测。
text_zh: 因此，应定期对鱼类养殖场所分离出的细菌进行耐药性及其变化趋势的实时监测。
text_en: Therefore, real-time monitoring of antimicrobial resistance and its trends in bacteria isolated from fish farming sites should be conducted regularly.

quote: Through the artificial infection test, the strain exhibited no pathogenicity to S. chuatsi , or did not cause any disease alone.
statement: 通过人工感染试验，该菌株对鳜鱼无致病性，或单独不引起任何疾病。
text_zh: 通过人工感染试验，该菌株对鳜鱼无致病性，或单独不引起任何疾病。
text_en: Through artificial infection trials, this strain is non-pathogenic to mandarin fish, or does not cause any disease on its own.

quote: The antibiotic sensitivity test showed that the strain was sensitive to piperacillin, carbenicillin, cefoperazone, cefazolin, ofloxacin, gentamicin, kanamycin, amikacin, neomycin, erythromycin, minocycline, doxycycline, polymyxin B, tetracycline, chloramphenicol, and other drugs.
statement: 抗生素敏感性试验显示该菌株对哌拉西林、羧苄西林、头孢哌酮、头孢唑林、氧氟沙星、庆大霉素、卡那霉素、阿米卡星、新霉素、红霉素、米诺环素、多西环素、多粘菌素B、四环素、氯霉素及其他药物敏感。
text_zh: 抗生素敏感性试验显示该菌株对哌拉西林、羧苄西林、头孢哌酮、头孢唑林、氧氟沙星、庆大霉素、卡那霉素、阿米卡星、新霉素、红霉素、米诺环素、多西环素、多粘菌素B、四环素、氯霉素及其他药物敏感。
text_en: Antibiotic susceptibility testing showed that this strain was susceptible to piperacillin, carbenicillin, cefoperazone, cefazolin, ofloxacin, gentamicin, kanamycin, amikacin, neomycin, erythromycin, minocycline, doxycycline, polymyxin B, tetracycline, chloramphenicol and other drugs.

quote: These species not only reject conventional pellet feeds but also show significant feeding reluctance toward dead bait, requiring the continuous provision of live bait fish during farming, which leads to increased production costs [ 2 ].
statement: 这些物种不仅拒绝常规颗粒饲料，而且对死饵表现出显著的摄食抗拒，养殖期间需要持续提供活饵鱼，导致生产成本增加。
text_zh: 这些物种不仅拒绝常规颗粒饲料，而且对死饵表现出显著的摄食抗拒，养殖期间需要持续提供活饵鱼，导致生产成本增加。
text_en: These species not only refuse conventional pellet feed but also show significant feeding resistance to dead bait, requiring the continuous provision of live bait fish during the farming period, which leads to increased production costs.

quote: Therefore, shifting S. chuatsi feeding habits from live prey to dead prey consumption, or even ultimately to artificial diets, re
statement: 因此，将鳜的摄食习惯从活饵转变为食用死饵，甚至最终转变为人工饲料，[文本截断]
text_zh: 因此，将鳜的摄食习惯从活饵转变为食用死饵，甚至最终转变为人工饲料，[文本截断]
text_en: Therefore, changing the feeding habits of mandarin fish from live bait to dead bait, and eventually to artificial feed, [text truncated]
intervention: Transition from live feed to formulated feed

quote: The unique feeding behavior of Siniperca chuatsi ( S. chuatsi ), which exclusively consumes live fry and rejects dead fry, severely limits the development of its aquaculture industry.
statement: 鳜鱼仅摄食活饵并拒绝死饵的独特摄食行为严重限制了其水产养殖业的发展。
text_zh: 鳜鱼仅摄食活饵并拒绝死饵的独特摄食行为严重限制了其水产养殖业的发展。
text_en: The unique feeding behavior of mandarin fish, which only consumes live bait and refuses dead bait, severely limits the development of its aquaculture industry.
outcome: 摄食行为与养殖发展限制

quote: This rejection of dead fry likely stems from an aversion to necromones (death-associated odors).
statement: 这种对死饵的拒绝可能源于对尸胺（死亡相关气味）的厌恶。
text_zh: 这种对死饵的拒绝可能源于对尸胺（死亡相关气味）的厌恶。
text_en: This rejection of dead bait may stem from an aversion to cadaverine (a death-related odor).

quote: Notably, when live prey fish were exposed to death-related odors, S. chuatsi lost interest in feeding, significantly reduced its attacks, or even ceased feeding entirely (Fig. 1 C).
statement: 值得注意的是，当活饵鱼暴露于死亡相关气味时，鳜鱼失去进食兴趣，显著减少攻击次数，甚至完全停止进食。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，当活饵鱼暴露于死亡相关气味时，鳜鱼失去进食兴趣，显著减少攻击次数，甚至完全停止进食。
text_en: It is worth noting that when live bait fish are exposed to death-related odors, mandarin fish lose interest in feeding, significantly reduce the number of attacks, and even completely stop eating.
intervention: Death odors applied to live bait

quote: The strains that were isolated in this study were from the gills of cultured S. chuatsi , and belonged to the same genus of Achromobacter , but sensitive to kanamycin, gentamycin, ofloxacin, chloramphenicol, and other antibiotics.
statement: 本研究中从养殖鳜鱼（S. chuatsi）鳃部分离的菌株对卡那霉素、庆大霉素、氧氟沙星和氯霉素等抗生素敏感。
text_zh: 本研究中从养殖鳜鱼（S. chuatsi）鳃部分离的菌株对卡那霉素、庆大霉素、氧氟沙星和氯霉素等抗生素敏感。
text_en: In this study, strains isolated from the gills of farmed mandarin fish (S. chuatsi) were sensitive to antibiotics such as kanamycin, gentamicin, ofloxacin, and chloramphenicol.

quote: On the other hand, it was resistant to ciprofloxacin, compound sulfamethoxazole, and other antibiotics ( Table 3 ).
statement: 该分离株对环丙沙星、复方磺胺甲恶唑和其他抗生素具有耐药性。
text_zh: 该分离株对环丙沙星、复方磺胺甲恶唑和其他抗生素具有耐药性。
text_en: This isolate is resistant to ciprofloxacin, trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, and other antibiotics.

quote: The strain was isolated from the gills of cultured S. chuatsi and showed resistance to a variety of antibiotics, which may be due to the environmental pressure caused by the abuse of antibacterial drugs in the process of cultivation.
statement: 从养殖鳜鱼鳃部分离的菌株表现出对多种抗生素的耐药性，这可能是由于养殖过程中滥用抗菌药物造成的环境压力所致。
text_zh: 从养殖鳜鱼鳃部分离的菌株表现出对多种抗生素的耐药性，这可能是由于养殖过程中滥用抗菌药物造成的环境压力所致。
text_en: Strains isolated from the gills of farmed mandarin fish exhibited resistance to multiple antibiotics, which may be due to environmental pressure caused by the abuse of antimicrobial drugs during the farming process.

quote: Further, a rational, scientific, and standardized drug use should be made, in order to control and reduc
statement: 此外，应进行合理、科学和规范的药物使用，以控制和减少[耐药性/疾病]。
text_zh: 此外，应进行合理、科学和规范的药物使用，以控制和减少[耐药性/疾病]。
text_en: In addition, reasonable, scientific and standardized drug use should be carried out to control and reduce [antibiotic resistance/disease].

quote: One-year-old S. chuatsi were divided into four groups (6 fish per group) and fed live prey ( D. rerio ), live prey with necromones (Live D. rerio immersed in a 1:1 mixture of cadaverine (1,5-Diaminopentane; Macklin, Shanghai, China, D766684) and putrescine (1,4-Diaminobutane; Macklin, Shanghai, China, D807415)
statement: 实验将一龄翘嘴鲌分为四组（每组6尾），并分别投喂活饵（斑马鱼）以及浸泡在尸胺和腐胺混合液中的活饵。
text_zh: 实验将一龄翘嘴鲌分为四组（每组6尾），并分别投喂活饵（斑马鱼）以及浸泡在尸胺和腐胺混合液中的活饵。
text_en: The experiment divided one-year-old Culter alburnus into four groups (6 fish per group) and fed them live bait (zebrafish) as well as live bait soaked in a mixture of cadaverine and putrescine.

quote: However, its aversion to dead prey sources poses a serious limitation to its farming development.
statement: 鳜鱼对死饵的厌恶对其养殖发展构成了严重限制。
text_zh: 鳜鱼对死饵的厌恶对其养殖发展构成了严重限制。
text_en: The aversion of mandarin fish to dead bait constitutes a serious limitation for its aquaculture development.
outcome: 摄食行为与养殖适应性

quote: To investigate the impact of death-related odors on the feeding behavior of S. chuatsi , we observed their predatory responses toward four types of prey fish (live prey without necromones, live prey treated with necromones (cadaverine and putrescine), dead prey with nec
statement: 为了研究死亡相关气味对鳜鱼摄食行为的影响，我们观察了它们对四种类型饵鱼的捕食反应（无尸臭素的活饵、用尸臭素处理的活饵、有尸臭素的死饵...）。
text_zh: 为了研究死亡相关气味对鳜鱼摄食行为的影响，我们观察了它们对四种类型饵鱼的捕食反应（无尸臭素的活饵、用尸臭素处理的活饵、有尸臭素的死饵...）。
text_en: To study the effect of death-related odors on feeding behavior in mandarin fish, we observed their predatory responses to four types of baitfish (live bait without cadaverine, live bait treated with cadaverine, dead bait with cadaverine...).

quote: This work paves the way for developing testable hypotheses for scientifically informed feeding modulation strategies.
statement: 这项工作为开发基于科学依据的饲喂调节策略的可测试假设铺平了道路。
text_zh: 这项工作为开发基于科学依据的饲喂调节策略的可测试假设铺平了道路。
text_en: This work paves the way for developing testable hypotheses for science-based feeding regulation strategies.

quote: Individual fish were adapted to 40 L recirculating aquaculture system water for 12 h.
statement: 实验鱼在40升循环水养殖系统水中适应12小时。
text_zh: 实验鱼在40升循环水养殖系统水中适应12小时。

quote: During stimulation, fish were maintained in a quiet, undisturbed environment to preclude external influences.
statement: 刺激期间，鱼被保持在安静、无干扰的环境中以排除外部影响。
text_zh: 刺激期间，鱼被保持在安静、无干扰的环境中以排除外部影响。
text_en: During the stimulation period, fish were kept in a quiet, undisturbed environment to exclude external influences.

quote: Forty-five minutes post-stimulation, fish were deeply anesthetized using MS222 (100 mg/L), after which olfactory epithelial tissue and brain tissue samples were rapidly dissected and collected using sterilized scissors and forceps.
statement: 刺激后45分钟，使用MS222（100 mg/L）对鱼进行深度麻醉，随后快速解剖采集组织样本。
text_zh: 刺激后45分钟，使用MS222（100 mg/L）对鱼进行深度麻醉，随后快速解剖采集组织样本。
outcome: 安乐死/取样过程中的痛苦最小化

quote: Ambient and water temperatures were maintained at 25 ± 1 °C, respectively.
statement: 环境温度和水温分别维持在25 ± 1 °C。
text_zh: 环境温度和水温分别维持在25 ± 1 °C。
text_en: Ambient temperature and water temperature were maintained at 25 ± 1 °C, respectively.

quote: Prior to sampling, all S. chuatsi were anesthetized using MS222 (100 mg/L) (Tricaine methanesulfonate, Sigma-Aldrich, MO, USA).
statement: 在采样前，所有鳜鱼均使用MS222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 在采样前，所有鳜鱼均使用MS222（100 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: Before sampling, all mandarin fish were anesthetized using MS222 (100 mg/L).

quote: Five healthy S. chuatsi individuals (238.2 ± 51.39 g; 8-month-old) were euthanised following approved ethical protocols.
statement: 五只健康的鳜鱼个体按照批准的伦理规程被安乐死。
text_zh: 五只健康的鳜鱼个体按照批准的伦理规程被安乐死。
text_en: Five healthy mandarin fish individuals were euthanized according to approved ethical protocols.

quote: To investigate temporal spx expression during fasting and dietary adaptation, S. chuatsi individuals were euthanised from both net-cage (fasting 3, 5, and 7 d, n = 5 per time point) and pond-fed (control) groups.
statement: 为了研究禁食和饮食适应期间spx基因的时间表达，从网箱（禁食3、5和7天）和池塘养殖（对照组）组中安乐死鳜鱼个体。
text_zh: 为了研究禁食和饮食适应期间spx基因的时间表达，从网箱（禁食3、5和7天）和池塘养殖（对照组）组中安乐死鳜鱼个体。
text_en: To study the temporal expression of the spx gene during fasting and dietary adaptation, mandarin fish individuals were euthanized from cage (fasted for 3, 5, and 7 days) and pond culture (control group) groups.

population.system: 网箱养殖; 池塘养殖

outcome: 禁食对生理指标的影响

quote: However, large-scale aquaculture of S. chuatsi is hindered by its obligate reliance on live prey, a consequence of its benthic, piscivorous feeding habits
statement: 鳜鱼大规模养殖受限于其对活饵的强制性依赖，这是其底栖食肉习性的结果。
text_zh: 鳜鱼大规模养殖受限于其对活饵的强制性依赖，这是其底栖食肉习性的结果。
text_en: Large-scale farming of mandarin fish is limited by its obligatory dependence on live bait, which is a result of its benthic carnivorous habit.
outcome: 摄食行为与养殖可行性

quote: Although the development of formulated feeds has alleviated this dependency, considerable challenges persist, including low voluntary feed intake, substantial variation in growth performance, and hepatic metabolic dysfunction, which are key bottlenecks to production at a commercial scale.
statement: 尽管配合饲料的开发缓解了这种依赖性，但仍存在自愿采食量低、生长性能差异大和肝脏代谢功能障碍等挑战，这些是商业化生产的关键瓶颈。
text_zh: 尽管配合饲料的开发缓解了这种依赖性，但仍存在自愿采食量低、生长性能差异大和肝脏代谢功能障碍等挑战，这些是商业化生产的关键瓶颈。
text_en: Although the development of formulated feed has alleviated this dependency, challenges such as low voluntary feed intake, large variation in growth performance, and liver metabolic dysfunction remain, which are key bottlenecks for commercial production.
outcome: 摄食行为、生长性能、肝脏健康

quote: Starvation challenge trials are essential during the habituation of S . chuatsi to formulated feed.
statement: 在鳜鱼适应配合饲料的过程中，饥饿挑战试验是必不可少的。
text_zh: 在鳜鱼适应配合饲料的过程中，饥饿挑战试验是必不可少的。
text_en: In the process of adapting mandarin fish to formulated feed, the starvation challenge test is essential.

quote: spx levels on day 7 exceeded those on day 3 ( Figure 3 ).
statement: 在分级饥饿条件下，鳜鱼第7天的spx水平高于第3天。
text_zh: 在分级饥饿条件下，鳜鱼第7天的spx水平高于第3天。
text_en: Under graded starvation conditions, the spx level of Chinese perch on day 7 was higher than on day 3.
outcome: 饥饿应激下的基因表达

quote: Experimental groups underwent starvation conditioning with sampling at 3, 5, and 7 days post-starvation, with five fish randomly collected from the net cage at each time point.
statement: 实验组进行了饥饿驯化，并在饥饿后第3、5和7天从网箱中随机采集五条鱼进行采样。
text_zh: 实验组进行了饥饿驯化，并在饥饿后第3、5和7天从网箱中随机采集五条鱼进行采样。
text_en: The experimental group underwent starvation acclimation, and five fish were randomly collected from the cages for sampling on days 3, 5, and 7 after starvation.

quote: After a 30 min feed withdrawal, surplus feed was removed upon cessation of feeding activity to establish a fasting condition for the net-caged cohort.
statement: 停喂30分钟后，在摄食活动停止时移除剩余饲料，以建立网箱群体的空腹状态。
text_zh: 停喂30分钟后，在摄食活动停止时移除剩余饲料，以建立网箱群体的空腹状态。
text_en: After withholding feed for 30 minutes, remove the remaining feed when feeding activity stops to establish a fasted state in the cage population.

quote: The caged individuals underwent a 3 d acclimatization period prior to the initiation of complete feed deprivation to prevent stress-induced mortality, whereas the pond population continued daily feeding.
statement: 网箱个体在完全断食前经历了3天的适应期以防止应激性死亡，而池塘群体则继续日常投喂。
text_zh: 网箱个体在完全断食前经历了3天的适应期以防止应激性死亡，而池塘群体则继续日常投喂。
text_en: Cage individuals underwent a 3-day adaptation period before complete fasting to prevent stress-induced mortality, while pond groups continued daily feeding.
outcome: 应激管理与死亡率预防

quote: No mortality was observed during the culture period.
statement: 在养殖期间未观察到死亡现象。
text_zh: 在养殖期间未观察到死亡现象。
text_en: No mortality was observed during the farming period.

quote: shifting S. chuatsi feeding habits from live prey to dead prey consumption, or even ultimately to artificial diets, represents a critical issue for reducing aquaculture costs.
statement: 将翘嘴鳜的摄食习惯从活饵转变为死饵或人工饲料是降低养殖成本的关键问题。
text_zh: 将翘嘴鳜的摄食习惯从活饵转变为死饵或人工饲料是降低养殖成本的关键问题。
text_en: Changing the feeding habits of topmouth cultriform carp from live bait to dead bait or artificial feed is a key issue in reducing aquaculture costs.
intervention: Transition from live feed to formulated feed

quote: although artificial domestication strategies have allowed S. chuatsi to accept artificial feed during the juvenile stage, the long domestication period and high difficulty have significantly limited the widespread use of this technology
statement: 虽然人工驯化策略使翘嘴鳜在幼鱼阶段接受人工饲料，但漫长的驯化周期和高难度限制了该技术的广泛应用。
text_zh: 虽然人工驯化策略使翘嘴鳜在幼鱼阶段接受人工饲料，但漫长的驯化周期和高难度限制了该技术的广泛应用。
text_en: Although the artificial acclimation strategy allows juvenile Chinese perch to accept artificial feed, the long acclimation period and high difficulty limit the widespread application of this technology.
outcome: 摄食行为与技术应用性
limitations: long domestication period and high difficulty (驯化周期长且难度大)

quote: These nitrogen-containing organic compounds are characterized by strong volatile foul odors, which can trigger innate aversive responses in vertebrates
statement: 这些含氮有机化合物具有强烈的挥发性恶臭，可触发脊椎动物的先天厌恶反应。
text_zh: 这些含氮有机化合物具有强烈的挥发性恶臭，可触发脊椎动物的先天厌恶反应。
text_en: These nitrogen-containing organic compounds have a strong volatile foul odor and can trigger an innate aversion response in vertebrates.

quote: These amines likely exacerbate S. chuatsi rejection of artificial diets, thereby increasing domestication challenges.
statement: 这些胺类物质可能加剧翘嘴鳜对人工饲料的拒绝，从而增加驯化挑战。
text_zh: 这些胺类物质可能加剧翘嘴鳜对人工饲料的拒绝，从而增加驯化挑战。
text_en: These amines may exacerbate the rejection of artificial feed by Siniperca chuatsi, thereby increasing domestication challenges.

quote: During this period, they were fed a formulated floating feed purchased from CP Group (diameter: 0.55 cm, crude protein ≥ 60%; total phosphorus ≥ 1.8%; crude fibre ≤ 7.0%; calcium ≤ 0.6–2.0%; crude fat ≥ 5.0%; lysine ≥ 1.8%; coarse grey powder ≤ 13.0%; moisture content ≤ 12.0%).
statement: 实验期间投喂CP集团购买的配合浮性饲料，并规定了具体的营养成分指标。
text_zh: 实验期间投喂CP集团购买的配合浮性饲料，并规定了具体的营养成分指标。
text_en: During the experiment, a formulated floating feed purchased from CP Group was fed, and specific nutritional composition indicators were specified.

quote: The daily feed ration for each experimental group was adjusted based on the individual size of the mandarin fish: a feeding rate of 4.2% of body weight per day was applied during the early grow-out phase (50–200 g), and a rate of 2.8% of body weight was used during the late grow-out phase ( 200 g).
statement: 根据鳜鱼个体大小调整日投喂量：早期生长阶段（50-200克）按体重的4.2%投喂，后期生长阶段（>200克）按体重的2.8%投喂。
text_zh: 根据鳜鱼个体大小调整日投喂量：早期生长阶段（50-200克）按体重的4.2%投喂，后期生长阶段（>200克）按体重的2.8%投喂。
text_en: Adjust the daily feeding amount according to the individual size of mandarin fish: in the early growth stage (50-200 g), feed at 4.2% of body weight; in the later growth stage (>200 g), feed at 2.8% of body weight.

quote: A net cage (1.8 m × 1.8 m × 1.4 m; 0.3 cm mesh size) was installed within the pond, and 25 individuals were randomly selected from the main stock and transferred into the cage.
statement: 在池塘内安装网箱，并从主群体中随机选取25尾鱼转入网箱。
text_zh: 在池塘内安装网箱，并从主群体中随机选取25尾鱼转入网箱。
text_en: Cages were installed in the pond, and 25 fish were randomly selected from the main population and transferred into the cages.

quote: Fasting experiments in E. coioides , S. argus , and Cynoglossus semilaevis have consistently shown substantial upregulation of hypothalamic spx expression in response to nutrient deprivation
statement: 禁食实验显示，在营养剥夺条件下，E. coioides、S. argus 和 Cynoglossus semilaevis 的下丘脑 spx 表达量显著上调。
text_zh: 禁食实验显示，在营养剥夺条件下，E. coioides、S. argus 和 Cynoglossus semilaevis 的下丘脑 spx 表达量显著上调。
text_en: Fasting experiments showed that hypothalamic spx expression was significantly upregulated in E. coioides, S. argus and Cynoglossus semilaevis under nutrient deprivation conditions.

population.species: E. coioides, S. argus, Cynoglossus semilaevis

quote: In Siberian sturgeon ( Acipenser baerii ), intraperitoneal administration of recombinant globular adiponectin protein ( SsgAd ) acutely inhibited feeding.
statement: 在西伯利亚鲟中，腹腔注射重组球状脂联素蛋白（SsgAd）会急性抑制摄食。
text_zh: 在西伯利亚鲟中，腹腔注射重组球状脂联素蛋白（SsgAd）会急性抑制摄食。
text_en: In Siberian sturgeon, intraperitoneal injection of recombinant globular adiponectin protein (SsgAd) acutely inhibits feeding.
intervention_record: 腹腔注射重组球状脂联素

quote: Transcriptional profiling indicated that spx expression was modulated by fasting and was associated with the degree of feed adaptation.
statement: 转录谱分析表明，spx表达受禁食调节，并与饲料适应程度相关。
text_zh: 转录谱分析表明，spx表达受禁食调节，并与饲料适应程度相关。
text_en: Transcriptome analysis showed that spx expression is regulated by fasting and correlates with the degree of feed adaptation.

quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that downregulation of spx in the liver and brain of large-sized S. chuatsi may facilitate increased feed intake by modulating hormonal profiles and repressing anorexigenic gene expression.
statement: 大规格翘嘴鲌肝脏和脑中spx的下调可能通过调节激素谱和抑制厌食基因表达来促进摄食量增加。
text_zh: 大规格翘嘴鲌肝脏和脑中spx的下调可能通过调节激素谱和抑制厌食基因表达来促进摄食量增加。
text_en: The downregulation of spx in the liver and brain of large-sized topmouth culpeo may promote increased feed intake by regulating hormone profiles and inhibiting anorexia gene expression.

quote: The study demonstrated that fasting significantly down-regulated FABP2 mRNA expression in the intestinal tissues of both species, while refeeding promptly restored expression to baseline levels.
statement: 研究表明，禁食显著下调了两种鱼类肠组织中的FABP2 mRNA表达，而复饲迅速将表达恢复至基线水平。
text_zh: 研究表明，禁食显著下调了两种鱼类肠组织中的FABP2 mRNA表达，而复饲迅速将表达恢复至基线水平。
text_en: Studies have shown that fasting significantly downregulated FABP2 mRNA expression in the intestinal tissue of two fish species, while refeeding rapidly restored expression to baseline levels.

population.species: gilthead sea bream; European sea bass

outcome: 营养状态对基因表达的调控

quote: Similarly, Xia et al. observed in Asian sea bass that short-term fasting (3d, 6d, 12d) markedly suppressed the expression of both fabp2a and fabp2b genes in the intestine [ 30 ].
statement: 类似地，Xia等人观察到在亚洲海鲈中，短期禁食（3天、6天、12天）显著抑制了肠道中fabp2a和fabp2b基因的表达。
text_zh: 类似地，Xia等人观察到在亚洲海鲈中，短期禁食（3天、6天、12天）显著抑制了肠道中fabp2a和fabp2b基因的表达。
text_en: Similarly, Xia et al. observed that short-term fasting (3 days, 6 days, 12 days) significantly inhibited the expression of fabp2a and fabp2b genes in the intestine of Asian sea bass.
outcome: 营养状态对基因表达的调控

quote: Based on the observed upregulation of spx expression in the intestine of S. chuatsi subjected to short-term starvation after feeding, this study proposes a regulatory hypothesis wherein spx may indirectly facilitate fabp2 gene transcription via the upregulation of PPAR-α expression.
statement: 基于观察到的鳜鱼在摄食后经历短期饥饿时肠道中spx表达的上调，本研究提出了一种调节假设，即spx可能通过上调PPAR-α表达间接促进fabp2基因转录。
text_zh: 基于观察到的鳜鱼在摄食后经历短期饥饿时肠道中spx表达的上调，本研究提出了一种调节假设，即spx可能通过上调PPAR-α表达间接促进fabp2基因转录。
text_en: Based on the observed upregulation of spx expression in the intestine of mandarin fish during short-term starvation after feeding, this study proposes a regulatory hypothesis that spx may indirectly promote fabp2 gene transcription by upregulating PPAR-α expression.

quote: The results showed that the addition of three probiotics at a concentration of 10 8 colony forming unit/mL to the culture water significantly increased the ratio of the pellet feed recipients and survival rate of mandarin fish ( Siniperca chuatsi ) under pellet-feed feeding.
statement: 在养殖水中添加三种益生菌显著提高了摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼接受率和存活率。
text_zh: 在养殖水中添加三种益生菌显著提高了摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼接受率和存活率。
text_en: Adding three probiotics to the culture water significantly improved the acceptance rate of pelleted feed and survival rate of mandarin fish.

quote: In addition, the three kinds of probiotics reversed the decrease in serum lysozyme and immunoglobulin M content, the decrease in the activity of antioxidant enzymes glutathione and catalase and the decrease in the expression of the appetite-stimulating regulator agouti gene-related protein of mandarin fish caused by pellet-feed feeding.
statement: 三种益生菌逆转了由颗粒饲料投喂引起的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶和免疫球蛋白M含量下降、抗氧化酶活性降低以及食欲刺激调节因子表达减少。
text_zh: 三种益生菌逆转了由颗粒饲料投喂引起的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶和免疫球蛋白M含量下降、抗氧化酶活性降低以及食欲刺激调节因子表达减少。
text_en: Three probiotics reversed the decrease in serum lysozyme and immunoglobulin M content, the reduction in antioxidant enzyme activity, and the decreased expression of appetite-stimulating regulatory factors caused by granular feed feeding in mandarin fish.
outcome: 免疫指标、抗氧化能力与食欲调节

quote: In terms of intestinal health, the three probiotics reduced the abundance of pathogenic bacteria Aeromonas in the gut microbiota and increased the height of intestinal villi and the thickness of foregut basement membrane of mandarin fish under pellet-feed feeding.
statement: 在肠道健康方面，三种益生菌降低了鳜鱼肠道微生物群中致病菌气单胞菌的丰度，并增加了前肠绒毛高度和前肠基底膜厚度。
text_zh: 在肠道健康方面，三种益生菌降低了鳜鱼肠道微生物群中致病菌气单胞菌的丰度，并增加了前肠绒毛高度和前肠基底膜厚度。
text_en: In terms of gut health, three probiotics reduced the abundance of the pathogenic bacterium Aeromonas in the gut microbiota of mandarin fish and increased the foregut villus height and foregut basement membrane thickness.
outcome: 肠道菌群结构与形态健康

quote: All experimental fish were acclimatized for two weeks in 3200 L rectangular aquaria to laboratory conditions before pellet-feed feeding.
statement: 所有实验鱼在投喂颗粒饲料前，在3200升的长方形水族箱中适应实验室条件两周。
text_zh: 所有实验鱼在投喂颗粒饲料前，在3200升的长方形水族箱中适应实验室条件两周。
text_en: All experimental fish were acclimated to laboratory conditions in 3200-liter rectangular aquaria for two weeks before being fed pellet feed.

quote: After the adaptive feeding, a total of 1350 healthy mandarin fish weighing 2.5 ± 0.1 g (mean ± standard error of mean (SEM)) were randomly allocated into one of five groups (270 fish per group): live bait fish feeding group (LBFD), pellet-feed feeding group with probiotics free (PFD), pellet-feed feeding group with L. plantarum plus (PFDLP), pellet-feed feeding group with L. rhamnosus plus (PFDLR) and pellet-feed feeding group with C. butyricum plus (PFDCB).
statement: 经过适应性投喂后，将1350条健康的鳜鱼随机分为五组：活饵投喂组、无益生菌颗粒饲料组、添加植物乳杆菌的颗粒饲料组、添加鼠李糖乳杆菌的颗粒饲料组和添加丁酸梭菌的颗粒饲料组。
text_zh: 经过适应性投喂后，将1350条健康的鳜鱼随机分为五组：活饵投喂组、无益生菌颗粒饲料组、添加植物乳杆菌的颗粒饲料组、添加鼠李糖乳杆菌的颗粒饲料组和添加丁酸梭菌的颗粒饲料组。
text_en: After adaptive feeding, 1350 healthy mandarin fish were randomly divided into five groups: live bait feeding group, probiotic-free pellet feed group, pellet feed group with Lactobacillus plantarum addition, pellet feed group with Lactobacillus rhamnosus addition, and pellet feed group with Clostridium butyricum addition.
intervention: Pellet feed vs live bait comparison

quote: However, there are still problems such as high mortality and slow growth of mandarin fish fed with pellet feed.
statement: 鳜鱼摄食配合饲料仍存在死亡率高和生长缓慢的问题。
text_zh: 鳜鱼摄食配合饲料仍存在死亡率高和生长缓慢的问题。
text_en: Feeding mandarin fish formulated feed still has problems of high mortality and slow growth.

quote: Probiotics intervention is an effective way to regulate the gut microbiota [ 27 ].
statement: 益生菌干预是调节肠道微生物群的有效方法。
text_zh: 益生菌干预是调节肠道微生物群的有效方法。
text_en: Probiotic intervention is an effective method for regulating the gut microbiota.

quote: In this study, three probiotics that have been shown to be safe for aquatic animals, L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum , were selected to investigate whether probiotics can improve the eating disorders of mandarin fish caused by pellet feed diet by modulating the gut microbiota, immune parameters, appetite and intestinal morphology, which may contribute to the theoretical foundation of probiotics intervention in the treatment of dietary disorders.
statement: 本研究选择三种对水生动物安全的益生菌（植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌），旨在探究益生菌能否通过调节肠道菌群、免疫参数、食欲和肠道形态来改善由配合饲料引起的鳜鱼摄食障碍。
text_zh: 本研究选择三种对水生动物安全的益生菌（植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌），旨在探究益生菌能否通过调节肠道菌群、免疫参数、食欲和肠道形态来改善由配合饲料引起的鳜鱼摄食障碍。
text_en: This study selected three probiotics safe for aquatic animals (Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, and Clostridium butyricum) to investigate whether probiotics can improve feeding disorders in mandarin fish caused by formulated feed by regulating gut microbiota, immune parameters, appetite, and intestinal morphology.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: Observations during the domestication of S . chuatsi to formulated feed indicated marked phenotypic variation among individuals, despite overall successful domestication.
statement: 在S. chuatsi驯化至配合饲料的过程中观察到个体间存在显著的表型变异，尽管整体驯化成功。
text_zh: 在S. chuatsi驯化至配合饲料的过程中观察到个体间存在显著的表型变异，尽管整体驯化成功。
text_en: Significant phenotypic variation among individuals was observed during the domestication of S. chuatsi to formulated feed, despite overall successful domestication.
intervention: Transition from live feed to formulated feed

quote: Although some individuals exhibited robust growth performance and good feed adaptation, others showed signs of growth retardation and poor adaptation to the feed.
statement: 虽然一些个体表现出强劲的生长性能和良好的饲料适应性，但另一些个体则显示出生长迟缓和饲料适应不良的迹象。
text_zh: 虽然一些个体表现出强劲的生长性能和良好的饲料适应性，但另一些个体则显示出生长迟缓和饲料适应不良的迹象。
text_en: Although some individuals exhibited strong growth performance and good feed adaptability, others showed signs of stunted growth and poor feed adaptation.
intervention: Transition from live feed to formulated feed
counterevidence: 部分个体出现生长迟缓和适应不良

quote: Gut microbiota can influence host eating behavior by directly affecting nutrient sensing, appetite and satiety-regulating systems through the production of neuroactive substances and short-chain fatty acids or indirectly manipulating intestinal barrier function, interacting with bile acid metabolism, modulating the immune system and influencing host antigen production
statement: 肠道微生物群可以通过产生神经活性物质和短链脂肪酸直接影响营养感知、食欲和饱腹感调节系统，或通过操纵肠道屏障功能、与胆汁酸代谢相互作用、调节免疫系统以及影响宿主抗原产生间接影响宿主的进食行为。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群可以通过产生神经活性物质和短链脂肪酸直接影响营养感知、食欲和饱腹感调节系统，或通过操纵肠道屏障功能、与胆汁酸代谢相互作用、调节免疫系统以及影响宿主抗原产生间接影响宿主的进食行为。
text_en: The gut microbiota can directly affect nutrient sensing, appetite, and satiety regulation systems by producing neuroactive substances and short-chain fatty acids, or indirectly affect host feeding behavior by manipulating gut barrier function, interacting with bile acid metabolism, regulating the immune system, and influencing host antigen production.

quote: Administration of probiotics is an effective strategy to maintain the balance of the gut microbiota
statement: 施用益生菌是维持肠道微生物群平衡的有效策略。
text_zh: 施用益生菌是维持肠道微生物群平衡的有效策略。
text_en: Administration of probiotics is an effective strategy for maintaining gut microbiota balance.

quote: In aquaculture, probiotics can prevent the spread of diseases, increase food conversion efficiency and stimulate growth by improving the composition of the gastrointestinal microbiota, strengthening the immune system and increasing the resistance to farmed stressors
statement: 在水产养殖中，益生菌可以通过改善胃肠道微生物群组成、增强免疫系统和提高对养殖应激源的抵抗力来预防疾病传播、提高饲料转化效率并刺激生长。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，益生菌可以通过改善胃肠道微生物群组成、增强免疫系统和提高对养殖应激源的抵抗力来预防疾病传播、提高饲料转化效率并刺激生长。
text_en: In aquaculture, probiotics can prevent disease transmission, improve feed conversion efficiency and stimulate growth by improving gastrointestinal microbiota composition, enhancing the immune system and increasing resistance to farming stressors.

quote: In D. rerio , spx1 knockout models exhibited markedly increased food intake compared with wild-type controls.
statement: 在斑马鱼中，与野生型对照相比，spx1敲除模型表现出显著增加的食物摄入量。
text_zh: 在斑马鱼中，与野生型对照相比，spx1敲除模型表现出显著增加的食物摄入量。
text_en: In zebrafish, the spx1 knockout model showed significantly increased food intake compared to wild-type controls.

quote: The superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, CAT activity, glutathione (GSH) content and malondialdehyde (MDA) content were determined according to the instructions provided in the commercial kits
statement: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性、CAT活性、谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量和丙二醛（MDA）含量按照商业试剂盒说明书进行测定。
text_zh: 超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性、CAT活性、谷胱甘肽（GSH）含量和丙二醛（MDA）含量按照商业试剂盒说明书进行测定。
text_en: Superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, catalase (CAT) activity, glutathione (GSH) content and malondialdehyde (MDA) content were determined according to the instructions of commercial kits.

quote: SOD, GSH, CAT and MDA measurements were based on the WST-1 method [ 74 ], xanthine oxidase method [ 75 ], ammonium molybdate colorimetric method [ 76 ] and thiobarbituric acid method [ 77 ], respectively.
statement: SOD、GSH、CAT和MDA的测量分别基于WST-1法、黄嘌呤氧化酶法、钼酸铵比色法和硫代巴比妥酸法。
text_zh: SOD、GSH、CAT和MDA的测量分别基于WST-1法、黄嘌呤氧化酶法、钼酸铵比色法和硫代巴比妥酸法。
text_en: The measurements of SOD, GSH, CAT and MDA were based on the WST-1 method, xanthine oxidase method, ammonium molybdate colorimetric method and thiobarbituric acid method, respectively.

quote: C. butyricum has a positive effect on immune function and is connected with increased population of Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus and decreased concentration of pathogenic bacteria in the intestinal tract of humans, mice, piglets and broiler chickens
statement: 丁酸梭菌对免疫功能有积极影响，并与人类、小鼠、仔猪和肉鸡肠道中双歧杆菌和乳酸菌数量的增加以及致病菌浓度的降低有关。
text_zh: 丁酸梭菌对免疫功能有积极影响，并与人类、小鼠、仔猪和肉鸡肠道中双歧杆菌和乳酸菌数量的增加以及致病菌浓度的降低有关。
text_en: Clostridium butyricum has a positive effect on immune function and is associated with increased numbers of bifidobacteria and lactobacilli and decreased concentrations of pathogenic bacteria in the intestines of humans, mice, piglets, and broilers.

quote: C. butyricum can inhibit intestinal inflammation and regulate gut microbiota through the immune pathway
statement: 丁酸梭菌可以通过免疫途径抑制肠道炎症并调节肠道微生物群。
text_zh: 丁酸梭菌可以通过免疫途径抑制肠道炎症并调节肠道微生物群。
text_en: C. butyricum can inhibit intestinal inflammation and regulate the gut microbiota through immune pathways.

quote: The preference for a live bait diet increases the cost of mandarin fish farming and the risk of infectious diseases, limiting the development of mandarin fish farming.
statement: 鳜鱼偏好活饵饮食增加了养殖成本并提高了传染病风险，从而限制了鳜鱼养殖业的发展。
text_zh: 鳜鱼偏好活饵饮食增加了养殖成本并提高了传染病风险，从而限制了鳜鱼养殖业的发展。
text_en: The preference of mandarin fish for a live bait diet increases farming costs and raises the risk of infectious diseases, thereby limiting the development of mandarin fish aquaculture.
outcome: 疾病风险与养殖可持续性

quote: For this problem, previous studies mainly focused on optimizing the domestication process and breeding conditions (such as temperature), strengthening the training of learning and memory and using attractants, which promoted the development of pellet feed for mandarin fish
statement: 针对这一问题，先前的研究主要集中在优化驯化过程和养殖条件（如温度）、加强学习和记忆训练以及使用诱食剂，这促进了鳜鱼配合饲料的发展。
text_zh: 针对这一问题，先前的研究主要集中在优化驯化过程和养殖条件（如温度）、加强学习和记忆训练以及使用诱食剂，这促进了鳜鱼配合饲料的发展。
text_en: Regarding this issue, previous studies have mainly focused on optimizing the domestication process and breeding conditions (such as temperature), strengthening learning and memory training, and using attractants, which has promoted the development of formulated feeds for mandarin fish.

quote: probiotics have become an alternative to antibiotics and other drug treatments in the aquaculture industry and are considered a new tool for disease control
statement: 益生菌已成为水产养殖业中抗生素和其他药物治疗的替代品，并被视为疾病控制的新工具。
text_zh: 益生菌已成为水产养殖业中抗生素和其他药物治疗的替代品，并被视为疾病控制的新工具。
text_en: Probiotics have become a substitute for antibiotics and other drug treatments in aquaculture, and are regarded as a new tool for disease control.

quote: It has been reported to reduce the adhesion and growth of harmful bacteria via producing antimicrobial compounds
statement: 据报道，植物乳杆菌通过产生抗菌化合物减少有害细菌的粘附和生长。
text_zh: 据报道，植物乳杆菌通过产生抗菌化合物减少有害细菌的粘附和生长。
text_en: It is reported that Lactiplantibacillus plantarum reduces the adhesion and growth of harmful bacteria by producing antimicrobial compounds.
outcome: 肠道菌群平衡/病原抑制

quote: improve the growth and feed efficiency of carp ( Catla catla ) [ 44 , 45 ], grouper ( Epinephelus coioides ) [ 46 ], tilapia ( Oreochromis niloticus ) [ 47 ], shrimp ( Penaeus indicus ) [ 48 ] and pacific white shrimp ( Litopenaeus vannamei ) [ 49 ]
statement: 植物乳杆菌被报道能改善鲤鱼、石斑鱼、罗非鱼、印度对虾和南美白对虾的生长和饲料效率。
text_zh: 植物乳杆菌被报道能改善鲤鱼、石斑鱼、罗非鱼、印度对虾和南美白对虾的生长和饲料效率。
text_en: Lactobacillus plantarum has been reported to improve the growth and feed efficiency of carp, grouper, tilapia, Indian shrimp, and whiteleg shrimp.

population.species: Catla catla; Epinephelus coioides; Oreochromis niloticus; Penaeus indicus; Litopenaeus vannamei

quote: enhance the immunity and survival rate of pacific white shrimp ( Litopenaeus vannamei ) [ 50 , 51 ] and tilapia [ 52 ]
statement: 植物乳杆菌被报道能增强南美白对虾和罗非鱼的免疫力及存活率。
text_zh: 植物乳杆菌被报道能增强南美白对虾和罗非鱼的免疫力及存活率。
text_en: Lactobacillus plantarum has been reported to enhance the immunity and survival rate of Litopenaeus vannamei and tilapia.

quote: Part of the water tank was replaced daily to remove waste and feces.
statement: 每天更换部分水箱以去除废物和粪便。
text_zh: 每天更换部分水箱以去除废物和粪便。
text_en: Partially change the water in the tank daily to remove waste and feces.

quote: When partially replacing the aquaculture water, an appropriate amount of L. plantarum , L. plantarum and C. butyricum was added to the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups to maintain the concentration at 1 × 10 8 CFU/mL.
statement: 在部分更换养殖水时，向PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组添加适量的植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌，以维持浓度为1×10^8 CFU/mL。
text_zh: 在部分更换养殖水时，向PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组添加适量的植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌，以维持浓度为1×10^8 CFU/mL。
text_en: When partially replacing the aquaculture water, an appropriate amount of Lactobacillus plantarum and Clostridium butyricum was added to the PFDLP, PFDLR, and PFDCB groups to maintain a concentration of 1×10^8 CFU/mL.

quote: The water quality of each tank was kept within the best physical parameter range, temperature (24.13 ± 0.52 °C), pH (7.41 ± 0.15), ammonia-nitrogen (0.27 ± 0.05 mg/L) and dissolved oxygen (7.52 ± 0.15 mg/L), during the experiment.
statement: 实验期间，每个水箱的水质保持在最佳物理参数范围内：温度(24.13±0.52°C)、pH值(7.41±0.15)、氨氮(0.27±0.05 mg/L)和溶解氧(7.52±0.15 mg/L)。
text_zh: 实验期间，每个水箱的水质保持在最佳物理参数范围内：温度(24.13±0.52°C)、pH值(7.41±0.15)、氨氮(0.27±0.05 mg/L)和溶解氧(7.52±0.15 mg/L)。
text_en: During the experiment, water quality in each tank was maintained within optimal physical parameter ranges: temperature (24.13±0.52°C), pH (7.41±0.15), ammonia nitrogen (0.27±0.05 mg/L) and dissolved oxygen (7.52±0.15 mg/L).

quote: During the feeding trial, the number of deaths in each group was recorded every day, and Kaplan Meyer’s (KM) survival analysis was used to evaluate the survival differences between groups.
statement: 在喂养试验期间，每天记录各组死亡数量，并使用Kaplan-Meyer生存分析评估组间存活差异。
text_zh: 在喂养试验期间，每天记录各组死亡数量，并使用Kaplan-Meyer生存分析评估组间存活差异。
text_en: During the feeding trial, daily mortality counts were recorded for each group, and Kaplan-Meyer survival analysis was used to assess differences in survival between groups.

quote: On days 7, 14 and 28 of pellet-feed feeding, twelve mandarin fish were randomly collected from each tank and then anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) for subsequent sampling.
statement: 在颗粒饲料喂养的第7、14和28天，从每个水箱随机采集12条鳜鱼，并用三卡因甲磺酸盐(MS-222)麻醉以便后续采样。
text_zh: 在颗粒饲料喂养的第7、14和28天，从每个水箱随机采集12条鳜鱼，并用三卡因甲磺酸盐(MS-222)麻醉以便后续采样。
text_en: On days 7, 14, and 28 of pellet feed feeding, 12 mandarin fish were randomly collected from each tank and anesthetized with tricaine methanesulfonate (MS-222) for subsequent sampling.

quote: Blood samples collected from the tail vascular vein of each fish were placed in centrifuge tubes and centrifuged at 4 °C and 4000 rpm for 15 min to separate the serum.
statement: 从每条鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，并在4°C和4000 rpm下离心15分钟以分离血清。
text_zh: 从每条鱼的尾静脉采集血液样本，并在4°C和4000 rpm下离心15分钟以分离血清。
text_en: Blood samples were collected from the caudal vein of each fish and centrifuged at 4°C and 4000 rpm for 15 minutes to separate serum.

quote: The observed species, Chao1, ACE and PD whole tree indices of the PFDLP group were higher than that of other groups, and there was significant difference compared with the LBFD and PFDCB groups ( p 0.05) ( Table 2 ).
statement: PFDLP组的观察物种数、Chao1、ACE和PD全树指数高于其他组，且与LBFD组和PFDCB组相比存在显著差异。
text_zh: PFDLP组的观察物种数、Chao1、ACE和PD全树指数高于其他组，且与LBFD组和PFDCB组相比存在显著差异。
text_en: The observed species number, Chao1, ACE, and PD whole-tree indices of the PFDLP group were higher than those of the other groups, and showed significant differences compared to the LBFD and PFDCB groups.
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌益生菌颗粒饲料

quote: PCoA cluster analysis indicated that three clusters were formed and separated between the bait fish diet group (LBFD), pellet feed group (PFD) and probiotic-treated pellet feed group (PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB) after being fed for 28 days ( Figure 8 ).
statement: 饲喂28天后，PCoA聚类分析显示饵料鱼组、颗粒饲料组和益生菌处理颗粒饲料组形成了三个分离的簇。
text_zh: 饲喂28天后，PCoA聚类分析显示饵料鱼组、颗粒饲料组和益生菌处理颗粒饲料组形成了三个分离的簇。
text_en: After 28 days of feeding, PCoA cluster analysis showed that the trash fish group, the pellet feed group, and the probiotic-treated pellet feed group formed three separate clusters.

quote: Mandarin fish in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups were treated with L. plantarum , L. plantarum and C. butyricum at a final concentration of 10 8 CFU/mL for one week, while the remaining two groups, LBFD and PFD, were not treated.
statement: 鳜鱼在PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组中分别用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌以10^8 CFU/mL的最终浓度处理一周，而LBFD和PFD组未进行处理。
text_zh: 鳜鱼在PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组中分别用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌以10^8 CFU/mL的最终浓度处理一周，而LBFD和PFD组未进行处理。
text_en: Mandarin fish were treated with Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, and Clostridium butyricum at a final concentration of 10^8 CFU/mL for one week in the PFDLP, PFDLR, and PFDCB groups, respectively, while the LBFD and PFD groups received no treatment.

quote: In this time, all fish received a live bait fish diet twice a day (at 06:00 and 18.00 h) at 5% of initial body weight.
statement: 在此期间，所有鱼每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂活饵鱼，投喂量为初始体重的5%。
text_zh: 在此期间，所有鱼每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂活饵鱼，投喂量为初始体重的5%。
text_en: During this period, all fish were fed live baitfish twice daily (at 06:00 and 18:00) at a rate of 5% of their initial body weight.

quote: During the period of pellet-feed feeding, the PFD, PFDCB, PFDLR and PFDLP groups of experimental fish were overfed from dead fish (1 week) to commercial feed (4 weeks) following the domestication process established by Liang et al. [ 67 ], while the LBFD group of experimental fish maintained a live bait diet.
statement: 在颗粒饲料喂养期间，PFD、PFDCB、PFDLR和PFDLP组的实验鱼按照Liang等人建立的驯化过程，从死鱼（1周）过渡到商业饲料（4周），而LBFD组的实验鱼维持活饵饮食。
text_zh: 在颗粒饲料喂养期间，PFD、PFDCB、PFDLR和PFDLP组的实验鱼按照Liang等人建立的驯化过程，从死鱼（1周）过渡到商业饲料（4周），而LBFD组的实验鱼维持活饵饮食。
text_en: During the pelleted feed feeding period, experimental fish in the PFD, PFDCB, PFDLR and PFDLP groups transitioned from dead fish (1 week) to commercial feed (4 weeks) according to the acclimation process established by Liang et al., while experimental fish in the LBFD group maintained a live bait diet.

quote: Each group of experimental fish was fed twice a day (at 06:00 and 18.00 h) at 5% of initial body weight to approximate satiation.
statement: 每组实验鱼每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂，投喂量为初始体重的5%，以达到近似饱食状态。
text_zh: 每组实验鱼每天两次（06:00和18:00）投喂，投喂量为初始体重的5%，以达到近似饱食状态。
text_en: Fish in each group were fed twice daily (at 06:00 and 18:00) at a ration of 5% of initial body weight to achieve approximate satiation.

quote: Hematoxylin and eosin (H.E.) were applied for the staining, and histological examination of the samples was carried out using an optic microscope (Nikon, Tokyo, Japan) with a digital camera (Nikon, Tokyo, Japan).
statement: 使用苏木精和伊红（H.E.）进行染色，并使用带数码相机的光学显微镜对样本进行组织学检查。
text_zh: 使用苏木精和伊红（H.E.）进行染色，并使用带数码相机的光学显微镜对样本进行组织学检查。
text_en: Samples were histologically examined using hematoxylin and eosin (H.E.) staining and an optical microscope equipped with a digital camera.

quote: on the 28th day of feeding, the POPFR of mandarin fish in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups was higher than that in the PFD group, and the PFDLP and PFDCB groups reached a significant level of difference ( p 0.05).
statement: 在饲养第28天，添加益生菌的组别（PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB）鳜鱼的POPFR高于未添加益生菌的颗粒饲料组（PFD），其中PFDLP和PFDCB组差异显著。
text_zh: 在饲养第28天，添加益生菌的组别（PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB）鳜鱼的POPFR高于未添加益生菌的颗粒饲料组（PFD），其中PFDLP和PFDCB组差异显著。
text_en: On day 28 of rearing, the POPFR of mandarin fish in the probiotic-supplemented groups (PFDLP, PFDLR, and PFDCB) was higher than that in the pellet feed group without probiotics (PFD), with significant differences observed in the PFDLP and PFDCB groups.

quote: This suggested that different feeding strategies of mandarin fish led to different intestinal community structures ( Figure 8 ).
statement: 不同的投喂策略导致鳜鱼肠道菌群结构不同。
text_zh: 不同的投喂策略导致鳜鱼肠道菌群结构不同。
text_en: Different feeding strategies lead to different gut microbiota structures in mandarin fish.

quote: The abundance of Aeromonas in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups was significantly lower than in the PFD group ( Figure 9 B).
statement: PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组中气单胞菌属(Aeromonas)的丰度显著低于PFD组。
text_zh: PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组中气单胞菌属(Aeromonas)的丰度显著低于PFD组。
text_en: The abundance of Aeromonas in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups was significantly lower than that in the PFD group.

quote: The highest POPFR of mandarin fish was recorded in PFDLP (81%) compared to PFD (68%) on the 28th day of feeding.
statement: 在饲养第28天，PFDLP组的鳜鱼POPFR最高（81%），而PFD组为68%。
text_zh: 在饲养第28天，PFDLP组的鳜鱼POPFR最高（81%），而PFD组为68%。
text_en: On day 28 of rearing, the POPFR of mandarin fish in the PFDLP group was the highest (81%), while that in the PFD group was 68%.

quote: Mandarin fish fed with pellet feed without probiotics supplemented had a lower survival rate than those fed with live bait at the end of the experiment ( Figure 2 ).
statement: 实验结束时，喂食不含益生菌的颗粒饲料的鳜鱼存活率低于喂食活饵的鳜鱼。
text_zh: 实验结束时，喂食不含益生菌的颗粒饲料的鳜鱼存活率低于喂食活饵的鳜鱼。
text_en: At the end of the experiment, the survival rate of mandarin fish fed probiotic-free pellet feed was lower than that of mandarin fish fed live bait.
intervention: Pellet feed vs live bait comparison
counterevidence: 颗粒饲料组存活率低于活饵组

quote: Application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum significantly reduced the decrease of the survival rate of mandarin fish caused by the pellet feed diet at the end of the experiment ( Figure 2 ).
statement: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著减轻了由颗粒饲料饮食导致的鳜鱼存活率下降。
text_zh: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著减轻了由颗粒饲料饮食导致的鳜鱼存活率下降。
text_en: The application of Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactobacillus rhamnosus and Clostridium butyricum significantly alleviated the decrease in survival rate of mandarin fish caused by a pellet feed diet.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: Mandarin fish in the PFD group had lower serum lysozyme content than that in the LBFD group at days 7, 14 and 28 of feeding ( Figure 3 ).
statement: 在饲养第7、14和28天，PFD组鳜鱼的血清溶菌酶含量低于LBFD组。
text_zh: 在饲养第7、14和28天，PFD组鳜鱼的血清溶菌酶含量低于LBFD组。
text_en: On days 7, 14, and 28 of rearing, the serum lysozyme content in mandarin fish in the PFD group was lower than that in the LBFD group.
intervention: Pellet feed vs live bait comparison
counterevidence: 颗粒饲料组血清溶菌酶含量低于活饵组

quote: Application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum reduced the decrease of the serum lysozyme content of mandarin fish caused by the pellet feed diet ( Figure 3 ).
statement: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌减轻了由颗粒饲料饮食导致的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶含量下降。
text_zh: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌减轻了由颗粒饲料饮食导致的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶含量下降。
text_en: Applying Lactobacillus plantarum, Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus and Clostridium butyricum alleviated the decrease in serum lysozyme content of mandarin fish caused by a pelleted feed diet.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: Compared with the PFD group, the content of serum lysozyme increased significantly on the 7th and 28th day in the PFDLP group and on the 14th day in the PFDLR group ( p 0.05) ( Figure 3 ).
statement: 与PFD组相比，PFDLP组在第7天和第28天的血清溶菌酶含量显著增加，PFDLR组在第14天的血清溶菌酶含量显著增加。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，PFDLP组在第7天和第28天的血清溶菌酶含量显著增加，PFDLR组在第14天的血清溶菌酶含量显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the PFD group, serum lysozyme content was significantly increased in the PFDLP group on days 7 and 28, and in the PFDLR group on day 14.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: The highest serum lysozyme content of mandarin fish was noticed in PFDLP after being fed for 28 days ( Figure 3 ).
statement: 饲养28天后，PFDLP组鳜鱼的血清溶菌酶含量最高。
text_zh: 饲养28天后，PFDLP组鳜鱼的血清溶菌酶含量最高。
text_en: After 28 days of rearing, the serum lysozyme content was highest in the PFDLP group of mandarin fish.

quote: The application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum motivated an elevation of GSH content and CAT activity ( Figure 5 B,C) and a reduced MDA content in the liver, gut and gill of mandarin fish in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups when compared to the PFD group ( Figure 5 D).
statement: 与PFD组相比，应用L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum促使PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组鳜鱼肝脏、肠道和鳃中的GSH含量和CAT活性升高，并降低了MDA含量。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，应用L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum促使PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组鳜鱼肝脏、肠道和鳃中的GSH含量和CAT活性升高，并降低了MDA含量。
text_en: Compared with the PFD group, application of L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum increased GSH content and CAT activity in the liver, intestine and gills of mandarin fish in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups, and decreased MDA content.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 氧化应激参数（GSH, CAT, MDA）

quote: The content of GSH in liver and gill of mandarin fish in the PFDLP group treated with L. plantarum was significantly higher than that in the PFD group ( p 0.05) ( Figure 5 B).
statement: 与PFD组相比，经植物乳杆菌处理的PFDLP组鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中的谷胱甘肽含量显著更高。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，经植物乳杆菌处理的PFDLP组鳜鱼肝脏和鳃中的谷胱甘肽含量显著更高。
text_en: Compared to the PFD group, glutathione content in the liver and gills of mandarin fish in the PFDLP group treated with Lactiplantibacillus plantarum was significantly higher.

quote: Compared with the mandarin fish in the PFD group, application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum significantly increased CAT activity in liver and MDA content in gill ( p 0.05) ( Figure 5 C,D).
statement: 与PFD组相比，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著增加了肝脏中的过氧化氢酶活性和鳃中的丙二醛含量。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著增加了肝脏中的过氧化氢酶活性和鳃中的丙二醛含量。
text_en: Compared with the PFD group, the application of Lactobacillus plantarum, Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus, and Clostridium butyricum significantly increased catalase activity in the liver and malondialdehyde content in the gills.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
counterevidence: 鳃中MDA含量增加通常指示氧化损伤加剧

quote: we found a significantly increased mRNA level of leptin in the gut of mandarin fish and a significantly decreased mRNA level of npy and agrp in the brain of mandarin fish in the PFD group compared to the LBFD group ( p 0.05) ( Figure 6 A,B).
statement: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组鳜鱼肠道中瘦素mRNA水平显著升高，脑中新神经肽Y和刺相关肽基因mRNA水平显著降低。
text_zh: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组鳜鱼肠道中瘦素mRNA水平显著升高，脑中新神经肽Y和刺相关肽基因mRNA水平显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the LBFD group, leptin mRNA levels in the intestines of mandarin fish were significantly increased in the PFD group, while neuropeptide Y and agouti-related peptide gene mRNA levels in the brain were significantly decreased.
intervention: Pellet feed vs live bait comparison

quote: After applying L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum , the leptin expression levels in the mandarin fish gut were significantly down-regulated in the PFDLP and PFDCB groups compared with that in the PFD group ( p 0.05) ( Figure 6 A,B).
statement: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌后，与PFD组相比，PFDLP和PFDCB组鳜鱼肠道中的瘦素表达水平显著下调。
text_zh: 应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌后，与PFD组相比，PFDLP和PFDCB组鳜鱼肠道中的瘦素表达水平显著下调。
text_en: After applying Lactobacillus plantarum, Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus, and Clostridium butyricum, the leptin expression levels in the intestines of mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi) in the PFDLP and PFDCB groups were significantly downregulated compared to the PFD group.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: The agrp expression levels in the mandarin fish brain were significantly up-regulated in the PFDLP, PFDLR and PFDCB groups compared with that in the PFD group ( p 0.05) ( Figure 6 A,B).
statement: 与PFD组相比，PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组鳜鱼脑中的agrp表达水平显著上调。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，PFDLP、PFDLR和PFDCB组鳜鱼脑中的agrp表达水平显著上调。
text_en: Compared to the PFD group, agrp expression levels in the brains of mandarin fish were significantly upregulated in the PFDLP, PFDLR, and PFDCB groups.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: Previous studies have shown that probiotics can influence the feeding behavior of the host by regulating the microbiota [ 26 , 27 , 86 ]
statement: 先前的研究表明，益生菌可以通过调节微生物群影响宿主的摄食行为。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，益生菌可以通过调节微生物群影响宿主的摄食行为。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that probiotics can affect host feeding behavior by modulating the microbiota.

quote: we observed that supplementation with either of the three probiotics effectively increased the POPFR in mandarin fish compared to those fed the same diet but without probiotics supplementation
statement: 观察到补充三种益生菌中的任何一种都能有效提高鳜鱼的颗粒饲料接受率（POPFR），与未添加益生菌的相同日粮组相比。
text_zh: 观察到补充三种益生菌中的任何一种都能有效提高鳜鱼的颗粒饲料接受率（POPFR），与未添加益生菌的相同日粮组相比。
text_en: Supplementation with any of the three probiotics was observed to effectively improve the pellet feed acceptance rate (POPFR) of mandarin fish compared to the same diet group without probiotic addition.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: pellet feed diet can lead to the reduction of survival rate of mandarin fish
statement: 颗粒饲料日粮会导致鳜鱼存活率降低。
text_zh: 颗粒饲料日粮会导致鳜鱼存活率降低。
text_en: Pellet feed diets lead to a decrease in the survival rate of mandarin fish.

quote: Results showed that L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum can significantly reverse the increase in mortality of mandarin fish caused by feeding pellets at the end of the 28-day experiment.
statement: 结果显示，植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌能显著逆转因投喂颗粒饲料导致的鳜鱼死亡率增加。
text_zh: 结果显示，植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌能显著逆转因投喂颗粒饲料导致的鳜鱼死亡率增加。
text_en: The results showed that Lactobacillus plantarum, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, and Clostridium butyricum significantly reversed the increase in mortality of mandarin fish caused by feeding pellet feed.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: probiotics such as L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum are generally regarded as safe for aquatic animals.
statement: L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum等益生菌通常被认为对水生动物是安全的。
text_zh: L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum等益生菌通常被认为对水生动物是安全的。
text_en: Probiotics such as L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum are generally considered safe for aquatic animals.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: In the present study, we observed that L. rhamnosus , L. plantarum and C. butyricum could reverse the decrease of agrp expression in the brain tissue of mandarin fish caused by pellet-feed feeding.
statement: 本研究发现，L. rhamnosus、L. plantarum和C. butyricum可以逆转由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼脑组织中agrp表达的降低。
text_zh: 本研究发现，L. rhamnosus、L. plantarum和C. butyricum可以逆转由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼脑组织中agrp表达的降低。
text_en: This study found that L. rhamnosus, L. plantarum and C. butyricum can reverse the decrease in agrp expression in the brain tissue of mandarin fish caused by granular feed feeding.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: This study showed that the treatment of L. rhamnosus , L. plantarum and C. butyricum can reverse the high expression of the peripheral hormone leptin in the intestinal tissue of mandarin fish caused by feed-pellet feeding.
statement: 本研究显示，L. rhamnosus、L. plantarum和C. butyricum的处理可以逆转由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼肠道组织中外周激素瘦素的高表达。
text_zh: 本研究显示，L. rhamnosus、L. plantarum和C. butyricum的处理可以逆转由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼肠道组织中外周激素瘦素的高表达。
text_en: This study showed that treatment with L. rhamnosus, L. plantarum and C. butyricum could reverse the high expression of the peripheral hormone leptin in the intestinal tissue of mandarin fish caused by pellet feed feeding.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: The abundance of human pathogens pneumonia and human pathogens nosocomial significantly increased in the PFD group compared with other groups ( p 0.05) ( Figure 11 ).
statement: 与对照组相比，投喂颗粒饲料（PFD）组的肺炎和医院获得性人类病原体丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，投喂颗粒饲料（PFD）组的肺炎和医院获得性人类病原体丰度显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the control group, the abundance of pneumonia and hospital-acquired human pathogens significantly increased in the pelleted feed diet (PFD) group.
outcome: 肠道微生物组成/病原菌丰度

quote: the result showed that C. butyricum , L. rhamnosus and L. plantarum could significantly increase the villi height of the foregut, midgut and hindgut of mandarin fish fed with pellet feed ( p 0.05; Figure 13 A)
statement: 丁酸梭菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和植物乳杆菌能显著增加摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼前肠、中肠和后肠的绒毛高度。
text_zh: 丁酸梭菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和植物乳杆菌能显著增加摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼前肠、中肠和后肠的绒毛高度。
text_en: Clostridium butyricum, Lactobacillus rhamnosus, and Lactobacillus plantarum significantly increased the villus height in the foregut, midgut, and hindgut of mandarin fish fed granular feed.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 肠道组织形态（绒毛高度）

quote: and significantly reverse the decrease in the thickness of foregut basement membrane caused by pellet-feed feeding ( p 0.05; Figure 13 B).
statement: 这些益生菌能显著逆转由投喂颗粒饲料引起的前肠基底膜厚度降低。
text_zh: 这些益生菌能显著逆转由投喂颗粒饲料引起的前肠基底膜厚度降低。
text_en: These probiotics can significantly reverse the reduction in foregut basement membrane thickness caused by feeding pellet feed.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 肠道组织形态（基底膜厚度）

quote: The increased mortality rate of mandarin fish under pellet feeding conditions seriously affects its economic benefits [ 10 , 66 ].
statement: 在颗粒饲料条件下，鳜鱼死亡率升高严重影响其经济效益。
text_zh: 在颗粒饲料条件下，鳜鱼死亡率升高严重影响其经济效益。
text_en: Under pelleted feed conditions, increased mortality of mandarin fish severely affects its economic benefits.

quote: Although the application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum reduced the decrease of the serum IgM level of mandarin fish at days 14 and 28 of feeding ( Figure 4 A), serum CRP content was not significantly affected by pellet feed and probiotics application ( Figure 4 B).
statement: 虽然应用L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum减少了鳜鱼在喂养第14天和第28天血清IgM水平的下降，但颗粒饲料和益生菌的应用对血清CRP含量没有显著影响。
text_zh: 虽然应用L. plantarum、L. rhamnosus和C. butyricum减少了鳜鱼在喂养第14天和第28天血清IgM水平的下降，但颗粒饲料和益生菌的应用对血清CRP含量没有显著影响。
text_en: Although the application of L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum reduced the decline in serum IgM levels of mandarin fish on day 14 and day 28 of feeding, the application of pelleted feed and probiotics had no significant effect on serum CRP content.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
counterevidence: 血清CRP含量未受显著影响

quote: Compared with the PFD group, the serum IgM content of the PFDLP group supplemented with L. plantarum was significantly increased at days 14 and 28 of feeding ( p 0.05) ( Figure 4 A).
statement: 与PFD组相比，补充L. plantarum的PFDLP组在喂养第14天和第28天的血清IgM含量显著增加。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，补充L. plantarum的PFDLP组在喂养第14天和第28天的血清IgM含量显著增加。
text_en: Compared to the PFD group, serum IgM levels in the PFDLP group supplemented with L. plantarum increased significantly on days 14 and 28 of feeding.
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌益生菌颗粒饲料

quote: GSH content and CAT activity in liver, gut and gill of mandarin fish in the PFD group were decreased compared with that in the LBFD group ( Figure 5 B,C), while the MDA level in liver, gut and gill was increased ( Figure 5 D).
statement: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组鳜鱼肝脏、肠道和鳃中的GSH含量和CAT活性降低，而肝脏、肠道和鳃中的MDA水平升高。
text_zh: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组鳜鱼肝脏、肠道和鳃中的GSH含量和CAT活性降低，而肝脏、肠道和鳃中的MDA水平升高。
text_en: Compared to the LBFD group, GSH content and CAT activity in the liver, intestine, and gills of mandarin fish were decreased in the PFD group, while MDA levels in the liver, intestine, and gills were increased.
outcome: 氧化应激参数（GSH, CAT, MDA）
counterevidence: 相对于LBFD组，抗氧化能力下降且脂质过氧化产物增加
