quote: All this indicates that probiotics treatment can promote the appetite of pellet feeding mandarin fish through reducing the expression of the peripheral appetite-suppressing hormone leptin and increasing the expression of the central appetite-promoting factor Npy/Agrp.
statement: 这表明益生菌处理可以通过降低外周食欲抑制激素瘦素的表达并增加中枢食欲促进因子Npy/Agrp的表达来促进饲料颗粒喂养鳜鱼的食欲。
text_zh: 这表明益生菌处理可以通过降低外周食欲抑制激素瘦素的表达并增加中枢食欲促进因子Npy/Agrp的表达来促进饲料颗粒喂养鳜鱼的食欲。
text_en: This indicates that probiotic treatment can promote the appetite of mandarin fish fed feed pellets by reducing the expression of the peripheral anorexigenic hormone leptin and increasing the expression of central orexigenic factors Npy/Agrp.

quote: In this study, the appetite-promoting effect of L. rhamnosus , L. plantarum and C. butyricum may be mediated by their regulation on the gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
statement: 在本研究中，鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌的促食欲作用可能是通过它们对鳜鱼肠道菌群的调节介导的。
text_zh: 在本研究中，鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌的促食欲作用可能是通过它们对鳜鱼肠道菌群的调节介导的。
text_en: In this study, the appetite-stimulating effects of Lactobacillus rhamnosus, Lactobacillus plantarum, and Clostridium butyricum may be mediated by their regulation of the gut microbiota of Chinese perch.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: We found that at the end of 28 days of cultivation, the three probiotics can increase the reduction of mandarin fish serum lysozyme and IgM content caused by pellet feed domestication, and L. plantarum is the most significant.
statement: 在28天养殖结束时，三种益生菌能够增加由颗粒饲料驯化引起的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶和IgM含量的减少，其中植物乳杆菌效果最显著。
text_zh: 在28天养殖结束时，三种益生菌能够增加由颗粒饲料驯化引起的鳜鱼血清溶菌酶和IgM含量的减少，其中植物乳杆菌效果最显著。
text_en: At the end of the 28-day culture period, three probiotics were able to increase the reduction in serum lysozyme and IgM content in mandarin fish caused by granular feed acclimation, with Lactobacillus plantarum showing the most significant effect.
outcome: 免疫指标（血清溶菌酶和IgM）

quote: All this is similar to the finding in a previous publication suggesting that the feed supplement of L. plantarum CCFM8661 restored the decrease in serum lysozyme of Nile tilapia caused by waterborne Pb exposure [ 113 ].
statement: 先前的研究报道，补充植物乳杆菌CCFM8661可恢复因水溶性铅暴露导致的尼罗罗非鱼血清溶菌酶下降。
text_zh: 先前的研究报道，补充植物乳杆菌CCFM8661可恢复因水溶性铅暴露导致的尼罗罗非鱼血清溶菌酶下降。
text_en: Previous studies reported that supplementation with L. plantarum CCFM8661 can restore the decrease in serum lysozyme in Nile tilapia caused by water-soluble lead exposure.

quote: This study proved that the addition of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum reversed the decrease in serum lysozyme and IgM content caused by pellet-feed feeding, which may further ameliorate eating disorders by regulating the appetite and gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
statement: 本研究证明，添加植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌逆转了由颗粒饲料喂养引起的血清溶菌酶和IgM含量下降，这可能通过调节鳜鱼的食欲和肠道菌群进一步改善摄食障碍。
text_zh: 本研究证明，添加植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌逆转了由颗粒饲料喂养引起的血清溶菌酶和IgM含量下降，这可能通过调节鳜鱼的食欲和肠道菌群进一步改善摄食障碍。
text_en: This study demonstrated that the addition of L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, and C. butyricum reversed the decrease in serum lysozyme and IgM levels caused by feeding with granular feed, which may further improve feeding disorders by regulating the appetite and gut microbiota of mandarin fish.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: This finding is consistent with a previous study in which the administration of L. plantarum to the rainbow trout at a dose of 10 6 CFU/g for 36 consecutive days significantly improved the survival rate of rainbow trout when attacked by Lactococcus garvieae [ 91 ].
statement: 这一发现与先前的研究一致，该研究表明连续36天以10^6 CFU/g的剂量向虹鳟施用植物乳杆菌，可显著提高受乳球菌攻击时的虹鳟存活率。
text_zh: 这一发现与先前的研究一致，该研究表明连续36天以10^6 CFU/g的剂量向虹鳟施用植物乳杆菌，可显著提高受乳球菌攻击时的虹鳟存活率。
text_en: This finding is consistent with previous research, which showed that administering L. plantarum to rainbow trout at a dose of 10^6 CFU/g for 36 consecutive days significantly improved the survival rate of rainbow trout when challenged by Lactococcus.

quote: Similarly, Hooshyar reported that L. rhamnosus ATCC 7469 significantly increased the survival rate of rainbow trout ( Oncorhynchus mykiss ) when attacked by Yersinia ruckeri [ 36 ].
statement: 同样，Hooshyar报道鼠李糖乳杆菌ATCC 7469在受到罗氏杆菌攻击时显著提高了虹鳟的存活率。
text_zh: 同样，Hooshyar报道鼠李糖乳杆菌ATCC 7469在受到罗氏杆菌攻击时显著提高了虹鳟的存活率。
text_en: Similarly, Hooshyar reported that L. rhamnosus ATCC 7469 significantly improved the survival rate of rainbow trout when challenged with R. salmoninarum.

quote: Duan reported that supplementation of C. butyricum (1 × 10 9 CFU/g) for 56 days improved the survival of black tiger shrimp ( Penaeus monodon ) after exposure to nitrite stress for 24 and 48 h [ 92 ].
statement: Duan报道补充丁酸梭菌（1×10^9 CFU/g）56天改善了黑虎虾在亚硝酸盐胁迫24和48小时后的存活情况。
text_zh: Duan报道补充丁酸梭菌（1×10^9 CFU/g）56天改善了黑虎虾在亚硝酸盐胁迫24和48小时后的存活情况。
text_en: Duan reported that supplementing with C. butyricum (1×10^9 CFU/g) for 56 days improved the survival of black tiger shrimp after 24 and 48 hours of nitrite stress.

quote: Proper nutrition can affect intestinal health through several pathways, including intestinal morphology, microbial diversity, intestinal barriers and oxidative status [ 93 ].
statement: 适当的营养可以通过多种途径影响肠道健康，包括肠道形态、微生物多样性、肠道屏障和氧化状态。
text_zh: 适当的营养可以通过多种途径影响肠道健康，包括肠道形态、微生物多样性、肠道屏障和氧化状态。
text_en: Proper nutrition can affect gut health through multiple pathways, including gut morphology, microbial diversity, gut barrier, and oxidative status.

quote: The improvement of survival of cultured animals after applying L. rhamnosus , L. plantarum and C. butyricum may result from their positive regulation of nutritional status, intestinal morphology, gut microbiota, oxidative status and immune system [ 38 , 94 , 95 ].
statement: 施用鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌后养殖动物存活率的提高可能源于它们对营养状况、肠道形态、肠道菌群、氧化状态和免疫系统的积极调节。
text_zh: 施用鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌后养殖动物存活率的提高可能源于它们对营养状况、肠道形态、肠道菌群、氧化状态和免疫系统的积极调节。
text_en: The increase in survival rate of farmed animals after administration of L. rhamnosus, L. plantarum, and C. butyricum may be due to their positive regulation of nutritional status, intestinal morphology, gut microbiota, oxidative state, and the immune system.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: In this study, the influence of probiotics intervention on eating disorders and its mechanism were studied using mandarin fish fed with pellet feed as a model.
statement: 本研究以摄食人工配合饲料的鳜鱼为模型，研究了益生菌干预对摄食障碍的影响及其机制。
text_zh: 本研究以摄食人工配合饲料的鳜鱼为模型，研究了益生菌干预对摄食障碍的影响及其机制。
text_en: This study used mandarin fish fed artificial compound feed as a model to investigate the effects and mechanisms of probiotics intervention on feeding disorders.

quote: Due to the complex interactions between the gut microbiota, immune system, appetite and oxidative stress, the causal relationship between them needs to be further investigated.
statement: 由于肠道微生物群、免疫系统、食欲和氧化应激之间存在复杂的相互作用，它们之间的因果关系需要进一步研究。
text_zh: 由于肠道微生物群、免疫系统、食欲和氧化应激之间存在复杂的相互作用，它们之间的因果关系需要进一步研究。
text_en: Due to the complex interactions between gut microbiota, immune system, appetite, and oxidative stress, causal relationships among them require further study.
outcome: 肠道健康与免疫/氧化应激

quote: More solutions, such as the application of other probiotics, prebiotics or immunostimulants, are worth investigating.
statement: 值得研究更多解决方案，例如应用其他益生菌、益生元或免疫刺激剂。
text_zh: 值得研究更多解决方案，例如应用其他益生菌、益生元或免疫刺激剂。
text_en: It is worth researching more solutions, such as applying other probiotics, prebiotics or immunostimulants.
intervention_record: 其他益生菌、益生元或免疫刺激剂

quote: It has been reported that gut microbiota plays a causal role in regulating the feeding behavior of the host and can directly or indirectly affect the appetite and food intake of the host
statement: 据报道，肠道微生物群在调节宿主摄食行为中起因果作用，并能直接或间接影响宿主的食欲和食物摄入量。
text_zh: 据报道，肠道微生物群在调节宿主摄食行为中起因果作用，并能直接或间接影响宿主的食欲和食物摄入量。
text_en: It is reported that the gut microbiota plays a causal role in regulating host feeding behavior and can directly or indirectly affect host appetite and food intake.

quote: In this study, compared with the live bait fish diet, the pellet feed diet changed the intestinal colony structure of mandarin fish, which may be mainly caused by changes in the dietary structure and also be affected by environmental stress (including dietary stress)
statement: 在本研究中，与活饵鱼饲料相比，颗粒饲料改变了鳜鱼的肠道菌群结构，这可能主要由膳食结构变化引起，同时也受环境压力（包括饮食压力）的影响。
text_zh: 在本研究中，与活饵鱼饲料相比，颗粒饲料改变了鳜鱼的肠道菌群结构，这可能主要由膳食结构变化引起，同时也受环境压力（包括饮食压力）的影响。
text_en: In this study, compared to live bait fish feed, pellet feed altered the gut microbiota structure of mandarin fish, which may be mainly caused by changes in dietary composition and is also influenced by environmental stress (including dietary stress).
outcome: 肠道菌群结构与饮食压力

quote: Disturbance of gut microbiota balance could lead to the establishment of harmful bacteria, causing disease problems
statement: 肠道菌群平衡的破坏可能导致有害细菌的建立，从而引发疾病问题。
text_zh: 肠道菌群平衡的破坏可能导致有害细菌的建立，从而引发疾病问题。
text_en: Disruption of gut microbiota balance may lead to the establishment of harmful bacteria, thereby triggering disease problems.

quote: Probiotics play an essential role in the welfare of the host by maintaining a healthier balance of intestinal microbiota, which provides a defensive barrier against colonization of harmful bacteria and stimulates the immune system
statement: 益生菌通过维持更健康的肠道菌群平衡，为抵御有害细菌定植提供防御屏障并刺激免疫系统，从而在宿主福利中发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 益生菌通过维持更健康的肠道菌群平衡，为抵御有害细菌定植提供防御屏障并刺激免疫系统，从而在宿主福利中发挥重要作用。
text_en: Probiotics play an important role in host welfare by maintaining a healthier gut microbiota balance, providing a defensive barrier against colonization by harmful bacteria, and stimulating the immune system.

quote: In this study, the addition of three probiotics significantly reduced the increased abundance of pathogenic bacteria Aeromonas caused by pellet-feed feeding, which may be achieved through the direct competition of probiotics on the abundance of pathogenic bacteria and indirect regulation of host immunity.
statement: 本研究中，添加三种益生菌显著降低了由颗粒饲料喂养引起的致病性气单胞菌丰度的增加，这可能是通过益生菌对致病性细菌丰度的直接竞争和宿主免疫的间接调节实现的。
text_zh: 本研究中，添加三种益生菌显著降低了由颗粒饲料喂养引起的致病性气单胞菌丰度的增加，这可能是通过益生菌对致病性细菌丰度的直接竞争和宿主免疫的间接调节实现的。
text_en: In this study, the addition of three probiotics significantly reduced the increase in the abundance of pathogenic Aeromonas caused by feeding with pelleted feed. This may have been achieved through direct competition by the probiotics against the abundance of pathogenic bacteria and indirect modulation of host immunity.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 肠道致病菌丰度/免疫调节

quote: In this study, compared with the LBFD group, the decrease of GSH content in gut, the decrease of CAT activity in gill and the increase of MDA content in gill in the PFD group reached significant difference levels ( p 0.05), indicating that the pellet diet induced oxidative stress in mandarin fish
statement: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组（颗粒饲料）鳜鱼肠道GSH含量降低、鳃CAT活性降低且鳃MDA含量升高，表明颗粒饲料诱导了鳜鱼的氧化应激。
text_zh: 与LBFD组相比，PFD组（颗粒饲料）鳜鱼肠道GSH含量降低、鳃CAT活性降低且鳃MDA含量升高，表明颗粒饲料诱导了鳜鱼的氧化应激。
text_en: Compared to the LBFD group, the PFD group (pellet diet) showed decreased intestinal GSH content in mandarin fish, decreased gill CAT activity, and increased gill MDA content, indicating that the pellet diet induced oxidative stress in mandarin fish.

quote: The low nutritional status and stress caused by the pellet diet may decrease antioxidant capacity in mandarin fish
statement: 颗粒饲料引起的低营养状态和压力可能会降低鳜鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 颗粒饲料引起的低营养状态和压力可能会降低鳜鱼的抗氧化能力。
text_en: The low nutritional status and stress caused by pellet diet may reduce the antioxidant capacity of mandarin fish.

quote: Furthermore, compared with the mandarin fish in the PFD group, application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum significantly increased CAT activity in liver and MDA content in gill ( p 0.05).
statement: 与PFD组相比，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著增加了肝脏中的CAT活性和鳃中的MDA含量。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌显著增加了肝脏中的CAT活性和鳃中的MDA含量。
text_en: Compared to the PFD group, application of L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum significantly increased CAT activity in the liver and MDA content in the gills.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 抗氧化酶活性及脂质过氧化产物

quote: Increased CAT activity and GSH content accompanied by decreased MDA levels was observed after the application of three probiotics compared with the PFD group, which indicates that L. rhamnosus , L. plantarum and C. butyricum could enhance the antioxidant capacity of the host
statement: 与PFD组相比，应用三种益生菌后观察到CAT活性和GSH含量增加以及MDA水平降低，这表明鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌可以增强宿主的抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 与PFD组相比，应用三种益生菌后观察到CAT活性和GSH含量增加以及MDA水平降低，这表明鼠李糖乳杆菌、植物乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌可以增强宿主的抗氧化能力。
text_en: Compared with the PFD group, increased CAT activity and GSH content and decreased MDA levels were observed after the application of three probiotics, indicating that L. rhamnosus, L. plantarum and C. butyricum can enhance the antioxidant capacity of the host.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: The three kinds of probiotics showed an excellent free radical scavenging ability in the oxidative damage of the liver, intestine, and gill tissues, which may be attributed to its ability in gut microbiota and immune system regulation.
statement: 这三种益生菌在肝脏、肠道和鳃组织的氧化损伤中表现出优异的自由基清除能力，这可能归因于其调节肠道菌群和免疫系统的能力。
text_zh: 这三种益生菌在肝脏、肠道和鳃组织的氧化损伤中表现出优异的自由基清除能力，这可能归因于其调节肠道菌群和免疫系统的能力。
text_en: These three kinds of probiotics showed excellent free radical scavenging capacity against oxidative damage in liver, intestinal and gill tissues, which may be attributed to their ability to regulate gut microbiota and the immune system.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌
outcome: 自由基清除能力/组织氧化损伤

quote: According to reports, lactic acid bacteria inhibit the growth of harmful bacteria by producing antimicrobial compounds and competing for nutrients and attachment sites [ 41 , 149 ].
statement: 据报道，乳酸菌通过产生抗菌化合物以及竞争营养和附着位点来抑制有害细菌的生长。
text_zh: 据报道，乳酸菌通过产生抗菌化合物以及竞争营养和附着位点来抑制有害细菌的生长。
text_en: It is reported that lactic acid bacteria inhibit the growth of harmful bacteria by producing antimicrobial compounds and competing for nutrients and attachment sites.

quote: The present result agrees with earlier findings where a similar decrease in pathogenic bacteria ( Aeromonas sp. and Pseudomonas sp.) was reported in giant freshwater prawn ( Macrobrachium rosenbergii ) feeding with a diet supplemented with L. plantarum [ 150 ].
statement: 当前结果与早期发现一致，即喂食补充植物乳杆菌饲料的罗氏沼虾中报告了类似的致病细菌（气单胞菌属和假单胞菌属）减少。
text_zh: 当前结果与早期发现一致，即喂食补充植物乳杆菌饲料的罗氏沼虾中报告了类似的致病细菌（气单胞菌属和假单胞菌属）减少。
text_en: The current results are consistent with earlier findings, which reported a similar reduction in pathogenic bacteria (Aeromonas and Pseudomonas) in Macrobrachium rosenbergii fed diets supplemented with Lactobacillus plantarum.
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌益生菌颗粒饲料

quote: This result is also consistent with the early discovery which reported that L. rhamnosus micro-granules administered for 30 days to tilapia larvae could significantly reduce the proportion of potentially pathogenic bacteria [ 38 ].
statement: 该结果也与早期发现一致，即给罗非鱼幼鱼施用鼠李糖乳杆菌微颗粒30天可显著降低潜在致病菌的比例。
text_zh: 该结果也与早期发现一致，即给罗非鱼幼鱼施用鼠李糖乳杆菌微颗粒30天可显著降低潜在致病菌的比例。
text_en: This result is also consistent with earlier findings that administering Lactobacillus rhamnosus microparticles to tilapia juveniles for 30 days significantly reduced the proportion of potential pathogens.

quote: After decapitation, samples from the pancreas were fixed in Bouin's solution.
statement: 样本在断头后用Bouin氏液固定。
text_zh: 样本在断头后用Bouin氏液固定。
text_en: Samples were fixed in Bouin's solution after decapitation.

population.species: Silurus asotus Linne; Siniperca scherzeri Steindachner

quote: According to Sewaka et al., L. rhamnosus increased the villous height in the proximal, middle and distal parts of the intestine of juvenile red tilapia ( Oreochromis spp.) [ 37 ].
statement: Sewaka等人报告，鼠李糖乳杆菌增加了幼年红罗非鱼肠道近端、中段和远端的绒毛高度。
text_zh: Sewaka等人报告，鼠李糖乳杆菌增加了幼年红罗非鱼肠道近端、中段和远端的绒毛高度。
text_en: Sewaka et al. reported that Lactobacillus rhamnosus increased the villus height in the proximal, mid and distal intestine of juvenile red tilapia.

quote: Our findings indicate that the application of probiotics could effectively promote the intestinal health of mandarin fish fed with pellet feed, which may benefit from repair of the intestinal microbial barrier.
statement: 研究结果表明，益生菌的应用能有效促进摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼的肠道健康，这可能得益于肠道微生物屏障的修复。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，益生菌的应用能有效促进摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼的肠道健康，这可能得益于肠道微生物屏障的修复。
text_en: The results indicate that the application of probiotics can effectively promote gut health in mandarin fish fed granular feed, which may be due to the repair of the intestinal microbial barrier.

quote: At the same time, the promoting effect of probiotics on intestinal health may be one of the reasons for the improvement of survival rate of mandarin fish fed with pellet feed.
statement: 同时，益生菌对肠道健康的促进作用可能是提高摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼存活率的原因之一。
text_zh: 同时，益生菌对肠道健康的促进作用可能是提高摄食颗粒饲料的鳜鱼存活率的原因之一。
text_en: At the same time, the probiotics' promotion of gut health may be one reason for the increased survival rate of mandarin fish fed granular feed.

quote: In summary, the present results confirmed that the application of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum could significantly improve the eating disorders of mandarin fish caused by pellet-feed feeding, which expressed as significantly increased POPFR and survival rate.
statement: 本研究结果证实，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌可显著改善由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼进食障碍，表现为POPFR和存活率的显著增加。
text_zh: 本研究结果证实，应用植物乳杆菌、鼠李糖乳杆菌和丁酸梭菌可显著改善由颗粒饲料喂养引起的鳜鱼进食障碍，表现为POPFR和存活率的显著增加。
text_en: The results of this study confirm that the application of L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum can significantly improve feeding disorders in mandarin fish caused by pellet feed, manifested as significant increases in POPFR and survival rate.
intervention: L. plantarum, L. rhamnosus, C. butyricum probiotics
intervention_record: 植物乳杆菌鼠李糖乳杆菌丁酸梭菌益生菌

quote: All of these may be related to the ability of probiotics to regulate gut microbiota, activate immunity, boost appetite, improve antioxidant capacity and protect intestinal tissues.
statement: 这些效果可能与益生菌调节肠道菌群、激活免疫、增强食欲、提高抗氧化能力和保护肠道组织的能力有关。
text_zh: 这些效果可能与益生菌调节肠道菌群、激活免疫、增强食欲、提高抗氧化能力和保护肠道组织的能力有关。
text_en: These effects may be related to the ability of probiotics to regulate gut microbiota, activate immunity, enhance appetite, improve antioxidant capacity, and protect intestinal tissue.
outcome: 免疫/抗氧化/肠道组织/食欲

quote: Results of the pH, the water temperature and the dissolved oxygen at depth 1m and 10m in the study site from November 1 2007 to March 7 2008.
statement: 研究记录了2007年11月1日至2008年3月7日期间，研究地点1米和10米深度的pH值、水温和溶解氧结果。
text_zh: 研究记录了2007年11月1日至2008年3月7日期间，研究地点1米和10米深度的pH值、水温和溶解氧结果。

quote: To partially or entirely replace the use of live foods for mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi ♀× Siniperca scherzeri♂) with frozen or artificial feeds, a detailed understanding of their digestive physiology and the influence of these replacements is needed.
statement: 为了部分或完全用冷冻饲料或人工饲料替代鳜鱼杂交种（翘嘴鳜♀×斑鳜♂）的活饵，需要详细了解其消化生理以及这些替代品的影响。
text_zh: 为了部分或完全用冷冻饲料或人工饲料替代鳜鱼杂交种（翘嘴鳜♀×斑鳜♂）的活饵，需要详细了解其消化生理以及这些替代品的影响。
text_en: To partially or completely replace live bait with frozen feed or artificial feed for the hybrid mandarin fish (Siniperca chuatsi ♀ × Siniperca scherzeri ♂), it is necessary to understand in detail their digestive physiology and the effects of these substitutes.

population.species: 鳜鱼杂交种 (Siniperca chuatsi ♀× Siniperca scherzeri♂)

intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed

quote: In contrast, histological changes were detected in mandarin fish fed with pellet feed.
statement: 与投喂活饵相比，投喂颗粒饲料的鳜鱼检测到组织学变化。
text_zh: 与投喂活饵相比，投喂颗粒饲料的鳜鱼检测到组织学变化。
text_en: Histological changes were detected in mandarin fish fed pellet feed compared to those fed live bait.

quote: Compared to mandarin fish fed on the live feed, the thickness of the foregut basement membrane in pellet feed-fed mandarin fish was significantly reduced, with similar results in other fish [ 88 , 152 , 153 ].
statement: 与投喂活饵的鳜鱼相比，投喂颗粒饲料的鳜鱼前肠基底膜厚度显著降低。
text_zh: 与投喂活饵的鳜鱼相比，投喂颗粒饲料的鳜鱼前肠基底膜厚度显著降低。
text_en: Compared to mandarin fish fed live bait, the thickness of the foregut basement membrane in mandarin fish fed pellet feed was significantly reduced.
outcome: 肠道组织结构（基底膜厚度）

quote: our results indicated that dietary supplement of L. plantarum , L. rhamnosus and C. butyricum enhanced the intestinal health development in mandarin fish by increasing the height of intestinal villi and the thickness of foregut basement membrane.

quote: The current use of live food for aquaculture is expensive and time consuming but can be alleviated by weaning fish to dry feeds.
statement: 使用活饵进行水产养殖成本高且耗时，但可以通过将鱼驯化至干饲料来缓解这一问题。
text_zh: 使用活饵进行水产养殖成本高且耗时，但可以通过将鱼驯化至干饲料来缓解这一问题。
text_en: Using live feed in aquaculture is costly and time-consuming, but this problem can be mitigated by acclimating fish to dry feed.

quote: Results have shown that total substitution of live food by a compound diet has produced good development, growth, and survival in European sea bass on a commercial scale (Cahu et al., 2003).
statement: 结果显示，在欧洲鲈鱼中完全用配合饲料替代活饵在商业规模上产生了良好的发育、生长和存活率。
text_zh: 结果显示，在欧洲鲈鱼中完全用配合饲料替代活饵在商业规模上产生了良好的发育、生长和存活率。
text_en: The results showed that complete replacement of live feed with formulated feed in European sea bass produced good development, growth and survival rates at a commercial scale.
intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed

quote: However, growth in many species of fish fed artificial feeds was slower than those fed the live food (Kvåle et al., 2007; Faulk and Holt, 2009).
statement: 然而，许多食用人工饲料的鱼类其生长速度慢于食用活饵的鱼类。
text_zh: 然而，许多食用人工饲料的鱼类其生长速度慢于食用活饵的鱼类。
text_en: However, many fish fed artificial feed grow more slowly than those fed live bait.

quote: This may be either because the nutrients in the artificial feeds failed to stimulate ingestion or the fish were unable to properly metabolize the absorbed nutrients.
statement: 这可能是因为人工饲料中的营养物质未能刺激摄食，或者鱼类无法正确代谢吸收的营养物质。
text_zh: 这可能是因为人工饲料中的营养物质未能刺激摄食，或者鱼类无法正确代谢吸收的营养物质。
text_en: This may be because the nutrients in artificial feed failed to stimulate feeding, or the fish were unable to properly metabolize and absorb the nutrients.

quote: Mandarin fish feed is still based on fresh fish however this is problematic as it involves a sanitary risk (live feed can be a source of pathogens or parasites), deterioration of water quality, and variability of nutritional value, as well as being impractical (Baynes and Howell, 1993).
statement: 鳜鱼的饲料仍然基于鲜鱼，但这存在问题，因为它涉及卫生风险（活饵可能是病原体或寄生虫的来源）、水质恶化以及营养价值的不稳定性，而且不切实际。
text_zh: 鳜鱼的饲料仍然基于鲜鱼，但这存在问题，因为它涉及卫生风险（活饵可能是病原体或寄生虫的来源）、水质恶化以及营养价值的不稳定性，而且不切实际。
text_en: The feed for mandarin fish is still based on fresh fish, but this poses problems because it involves hygiene risks (live bait may be a source of pathogens or parasites), water quality deterioration, and unstable nutritional value, and is impractical.
outcome: 卫生风险、水质、营养价值稳定性

quote: Therefore, the development of a good quality formulated diet is essential for the expansion of mandarin fish culture.
statement: 因此，开发高质量的配合饲料对于扩大鳜鱼养殖至关重要。
text_zh: 因此，开发高质量的配合饲料对于扩大鳜鱼养殖至关重要。
text_en: Therefore, the development of high-quality formulated feed is crucial for expanding the farming of mandarin fish.

quote: The weaning of the test fish began 32 days post hatch.
statement: 试验鱼的断奶过程在孵化后第32天开始。
text_zh: 试验鱼的断奶过程在孵化后第32天开始。
text_en: The weaning process of the test fish started on day 32 post-hatching.

quote: The fish were first starved for 2 days to enhance their appetite, after which fresh dead fish were given for 2 days.
statement: 鱼首先被禁食2天以增强食欲，随后投喂新鲜死鱼2天。
text_zh: 鱼首先被禁食2天以增强食欲，随后投喂新鲜死鱼2天。
text_en: Fish were first fasted for 2 days to enhance appetite, then fed fresh dead fish for 2 days.

quote: Mixed diets of 50% commercial feed and 50% minced fillets helped fish to acclimate to the artificial feed.
statement: 50%商业饲料和50%碎肉混合日粮有助于鱼类适应人工饲料。
text_zh: 50%商业饲料和50%碎肉混合日粮有助于鱼类适应人工饲料。
text_en: A mixed diet of 50% commercial feed and 50% minced meat helps fish adapt to artificial feed.

quote: After 7 days of mixed feeding, the fish were fed with the artificial feed only.
statement: 经过7天的混合投喂后，鱼仅喂食人工饲料。
text_zh: 经过7天的混合投喂后，鱼仅喂食人工饲料。
text_en: After 7 days of mixed feeding, the fish were fed only artificial feed.
intervention: Replacing live bait with artificial feed

quote: 180 fish of similar size (average weight, 37.59 ± 0.21 g) were randomly stocked into nine 250-L aquaria.
statement: 180条大小相似的鱼（平均体重37.59 ± 0.21克）被随机放入九个250升的水族箱中。
text_zh: 180条大小相似的鱼（平均体重37.59 ± 0.21克）被随机放入九个250升的水族箱中。
text_en: 180 fish of similar size (mean body weight 37.59 ± 0.21 g) were randomly placed into nine 250-liter aquariums.

quote: Fresh and frozen feed were offered to fish at a rate of 4.0-5.0% body weight daily divided into two equal feedings at 9:00 A.M. and 16:00 P.M.
statement: 新鲜和冷冻饲料按每日体重的4.0-5.0%投喂，分为上午9点和下午4点两次等量投喂。
text_zh: 新鲜和冷冻饲料按每日体重的4.0-5.0%投喂，分为上午9点和下午4点两次等量投喂。
text_en: Fresh and frozen feed was fed at 4.0-5.0% of body weight per day, divided into two equal portions at 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM.

quote: Fish fed artificial feed had the lowest levels of protease activity and they were significantly lower than fish fed frozen feed.
statement: 饲喂人工饲料的鱼蛋白酶活性最低，且显著低于饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂人工饲料的鱼蛋白酶活性最低，且显著低于饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼。
text_en: Fish fed artificial feed had the lowest protease activity, which was significantly lower than that of fish fed frozen feed.

quote: No significant differences were found in the lipase activities of the stomach and the gut among fish fed different kinds of feed.
statement: 不同饲料组间胃和肠的脂肪酶活性无显著差异。
text_zh: 不同饲料组间胃和肠的脂肪酶活性无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in lipase activity in the stomach and intestine between different feed groups.

quote: However, the lipase activity of fish fed frozen feed was higher than in the other two treatments.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的脂肪酶活性高于其他两种处理组。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的脂肪酶活性高于其他两种处理组。
text_en: The lipase activity of fish fed frozen feed was higher than that of the other two treatment groups.

quote: The lipase activity in the liver of fish fed frozen feed was significantly higher than fish fed artificial feed, however there were no significant differences between the live food and frozen feed groups.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的肝脏脂肪酶活性显著高于饲喂人工饲料的鱼，但活饵组和冷冻饲料组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的肝脏脂肪酶活性显著高于饲喂人工饲料的鱼，但活饵组和冷冻饲料组之间无显著差异。
text_en: The hepatic lipase activity of fish fed frozen feed was significantly higher than that of fish fed artificial feed, but there was no significant difference between the live bait group and the frozen feed group.

quote: The amylase activity in liver of fish fed frozen feed was significantly higher than fish fed live feed.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的肝脏淀粉酶活性显著高于饲喂活饵的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饲料的鱼的肝脏淀粉酶活性显著高于饲喂活饵的鱼。
text_en: The liver amylase activity of fish fed frozen feed was significantly higher than that of fish fed live bait.

quote: The experiment was conducted in a recirculation system for 10 weeks.
statement: 实验在循环水系统中进行了10周。
text_zh: 实验在循环水系统中进行了10周。
text_en: The experiment was conducted for 10 weeks in a recirculating aquaculture system.

quote: At termination of the feeding trial, protease activity in the alimentary tract and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the livers of fish fed frozen feed were significantly higher than those fed artificial feeds.
statement: 在饲喂试验结束时，喂食冷冻饲料的鱼消化道中的蛋白酶活性以及肝脏中的天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）显著高于喂食人工饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 在饲喂试验结束时，喂食冷冻饲料的鱼消化道中的蛋白酶活性以及肝脏中的天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）显著高于喂食人工饲料的鱼。
text_en: At the end of the feeding trial, protease activity in the digestive tract and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) in the liver were significantly higher in fish fed frozen feed than in fish fed artificial feed.
outcome: 消化酶活性与肝酶水平

quote: Fish fed artificial feed had the highest AST and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) serum activity in serum which suggests that the liver was damaged to some extent.
statement: 喂食人工饲料的鱼血清中AST和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性最高，这表明肝脏受到了一定程度的损伤。
text_zh: 喂食人工饲料的鱼血清中AST和丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性最高，这表明肝脏受到了一定程度的损伤。
text_en: Fish fed artificial feed had the highest serum AST and alanine aminotransferase (ALT) activity, indicating a certain degree of liver damage.

quote: These results were further confirmed by histology of the liver.
statement: 这些结果通过肝脏组织学检查得到了进一步证实。
text_zh: 这些结果通过肝脏组织学检查得到了进一步证实。
text_en: These results were further confirmed by liver histological examination.

quote: Fish fed the artificial feed had serious hepatocyte vacuolization and disorganization.
statement: 喂食人工饲料的鱼出现了严重的肝细胞空泡化和紊乱。
text_zh: 喂食人工饲料的鱼出现了严重的肝细胞空泡化和紊乱。
text_en: Fish fed artificial feed showed severe hepatocyte vacuolization and disorganization.

quote: The mucosal epithelium of intestine in fish fed frozen and artificial feed had poorly developed enterocytes with a shortening of the microvilli, decreased absorptive vacuoles and hyperplasia of the lamina propia.
statement: 喂食冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼的肠黏膜上皮具有发育不良的肠细胞，伴有微绒毛缩短、吸收空泡减少和固有层增生。
text_zh: 喂食冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼的肠黏膜上皮具有发育不良的肠细胞，伴有微绒毛缩短、吸收空泡减少和固有层增生。
text_en: Fish fed frozen feed and artificial feed have dysplastic enterocytes in the intestinal mucosal epithelium, accompanied by shortened microvilli, reduced absorptive vacuoles, and lamina propria hyperplasia.

quote: n In addition to tissue damage there was a reduction in the ability of fish to digest frozen and artificial feed.
statement: 除了组织损伤外，鱼对冷冻饲料和人工饲料的消化能力也降低了。
text_zh: 除了组织损伤外，鱼对冷冻饲料和人工饲料的消化能力也降低了。
text_en: In addition to tissue damage, the fish's digestive capacity for frozen feed and artificial feed was also reduced.

quote: The results of this study indicate that the mandarin fish hybrid readily feeds on frozen and artificial feeds.
statement: 本研究结果表明，鳜鱼杂交种容易摄食冷冻饲料和人工饲料。
text_zh: 本研究结果表明，鳜鱼杂交种容易摄食冷冻饲料和人工饲料。
text_en: The results of this study indicate that hybrid mandarin fish easily consume frozen feed and artificial feed.

quote: However, a more appropriate artificial feed for this species is needed to improve the digestive function and histology of the digestive tract.
statement: 然而，需要为该物种开发更合适的人工饲料，以改善其消化功能和消化道的组织学状况。
text_zh: 然而，需要为该物种开发更合适的人工饲料，以改善其消化功能和消化道的组织学状况。
text_en: However, more suitable artificial feeds need to be developed for this species to improve its digestive function and the histological condition of the digestive tract.

quote: AST activity in liver of fish fed frozen feed was significantly lower than in fish fed live feed, but was significantly higher than in fish fed artificial feed.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饵料的鱼肝脏天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性显著低于饲喂活饵的鱼，但显著高于饲喂人工饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饵料的鱼肝脏天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）活性显著低于饲喂活饵的鱼，但显著高于饲喂人工饲料的鱼。
text_en: The liver aspartate aminotransferase (AST) activity in fish fed frozen bait was significantly lower than that in fish fed live bait, but significantly higher than that in fish fed artificial feed.

quote: No significant differences in the ALT activity in liver were observed among treatments.
statement: 各处理组间肝脏丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性无显著差异。
text_zh: 各处理组间肝脏丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）活性无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in liver alanine aminotransferase (ALT) activity among the treatment groups.

quote: The AST and ALT activity in serum of fish fed artificial feed was significantly higher than in fish fed live feed,
statement: 饲喂人工饲料的鱼血清中AST和ALT活性显著高于饲喂活饵的鱼。
text_zh: 饲喂人工饲料的鱼血清中AST和ALT活性显著高于饲喂活饵的鱼。
text_en: The serum AST and ALT activities in fish fed artificial feed were significantly higher than those in fish fed live bait.

quote: however, no significant differences were observed between fish fed artificial and frozen feed (Table 3).
statement: 然而，饲喂人工饲料和冷冻饵料的鱼之间未观察到显著差异。
text_zh: 然而，饲喂人工饲料和冷冻饵料的鱼之间未观察到显著差异。
text_en: However, no significant difference was observed between fish fed artificial feed and frozen bait.

statement: 使用 Orion 3-star plus pH计测量pH值。
text_en: 使用 Orion 3-star plus pH计测量pH值。

quote: The intestinal tissue of fish fed live feed was normal. The mucosal epithelium had well-developed enterocytes with prominent microvilli.
statement: 饲喂活饵的鱼肠道组织正常，肠上皮细胞发育良好且微绒毛明显。
text_zh: 饲喂活饵的鱼肠道组织正常，肠上皮细胞发育良好且微绒毛明显。
text_en: The intestinal tissue of fish fed live bait was normal, with well-developed intestinal epithelial cells and prominent microvilli.

quote: Fish fed frozen (Fig 2) and artificial feed (Fig 3) exhibited pronounced pathological changes of the intestinal epithelium.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饵料和人工饲料的鱼表现出明显的肠上皮病理变化。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饵料和人工饲料的鱼表现出明显的肠上皮病理变化。
text_en: Fish fed frozen bait and artificial feed showed obvious pathological changes in the intestinal epithelium.

quote: The mucosal epithelium had poorly developed enterocytes with shortening of microvilli and decreasing absorptive vacuoles, and hyperplasia of the lamina propia was also observed.
statement: 肠黏膜上皮细胞发育不良，微绒毛缩短，吸收空泡减少，并观察到固有层增生。
text_zh: 肠黏膜上皮细胞发育不良，微绒毛缩短，吸收空泡减少，并观察到固有层增生。
text_en: The intestinal mucosal epithelial cells were dysplastic, the microvilli were shortened, absorption vacuoles were reduced, and proliferation of the lamina propria was observed.

quote: The tunica muscularis of fish fed frozen bait fish was thicker than fish fed artificial feed and thinner than fish fed fresh bait fish.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饵料的鱼的肌层比饲喂人工饲料的鱼厚，但比饲喂新鲜饵料的鱼薄。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饵料的鱼的肌层比饲喂人工饲料的鱼厚，但比饲喂新鲜饵料的鱼薄。
text_en: The muscle layer of fish fed frozen bait was thicker than that of fish fed artificial feed, but thinner than that of fish fed fresh bait.

quote: Liver samples from fish fed fresh feed showed normal histology (Fig. 4). The hepatocytes were regular and compact.
statement: 饲喂新鲜饵料的鱼的肝脏样本显示正常组织学结构，肝细胞规则且紧密。
text_zh: 饲喂新鲜饵料的鱼的肝脏样本显示正常组织学结构，肝细胞规则且紧密。
text_en: Liver samples from fish fed fresh bait showed normal histological structure, with regular and tightly packed hepatocytes.

quote: The activity of protease in the stomach, liver, and intestine of fish fed live feed were highest and significantly higher (P < 0.05) than those of fish fed frozen or artificial feed (Table 2).
statement: 投喂活饵的鱼胃、肝和肠中的蛋白酶活性最高，且显著高于投喂冷冻或人工饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 投喂活饵的鱼胃、肝和肠中的蛋白酶活性最高，且显著高于投喂冷冻或人工饲料的鱼。
text_en: Protease activity in the stomach, liver, and intestine of fish fed live bait was the highest, and significantly higher than that of fish fed frozen or artificial feed.

quote: Significantly higher ALT and AST levels in serum were found in hybrid mandarin fish fed the artificial feed.
statement: 饲喂人工饲料的杂交鳜鱼血清中ALT和AST水平显著升高。
text_zh: 饲喂人工饲料的杂交鳜鱼血清中ALT和AST水平显著升高。
text_en: Serum ALT and AST levels were significantly elevated in hybrid mandarin fish fed artificial feed.

quote: These results suggest that fish liver could have been damaged to some extent and have affected the process of protein metabolism.
statement: 这些结果表明鱼肝可能受到了一定程度的损伤并影响了蛋白质代谢过程。
text_zh: 这些结果表明鱼肝可能受到了一定程度的损伤并影响了蛋白质代谢过程。
text_en: These results indicate that the fish liver may have sustained a certain degree of damage and affected the protein metabolism process.
outcome: 肝脏健康与蛋白质代谢

quote: These results are in agreement with the histology of the liver of fish fed artificial feed which caused serious hepatocyte vacuolization and disorganization.
statement: 这些结果与饲喂人工饲料的鱼肝脏组织学观察一致，后者导致了严重的肝细胞空泡化和紊乱。
text_zh: 这些结果与饲喂人工饲料的鱼肝脏组织学观察一致，后者导致了严重的肝细胞空泡化和紊乱。
text_en: These results are consistent with histological observations of the liver tissue in fish fed artificial feed, which led to severe hepatocyte vacuolation and disorganization.

quote: This may indicate that hybrid mandarin fish cannot totally adapt to artificial feed.
statement: 这可能表明杂交鳜鱼不能完全适应人工饲料。
text_zh: 这可能表明杂交鳜鱼不能完全适应人工饲料。
text_en: This may indicate that hybrid mandarin fish cannot fully adapt to artificial feed.

quote: In this experiment, the liver of fish fed artificial feed exhibited pathological changes.
statement: 在本实验中，饲喂人工饲料的鱼肝脏表现出病理变化。
text_zh: 在本实验中，饲喂人工饲料的鱼肝脏表现出病理变化。
text_en: In this experiment, fish fed artificial feed showed pathological changes in the liver.

quote: The reduced amount of goblet cells in the intestine of fish fed frozen and artificial feed suggests a decrease in the defense mechanism of the fish.
statement: 饲喂冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼肠道中杯状细胞数量减少，表明鱼的防御机制减弱。
text_zh: 饲喂冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼肠道中杯状细胞数量减少，表明鱼的防御机制减弱。
text_en: The number of goblet cells in the intestines of fish fed frozen feed and artificial feed decreased, indicating a weakened defense mechanism in the fish.

quote: In addition, the intestine of fish fed frozen and artificial feed exhibited pronounced pathological changes which negatively affected the digestion and absorption of feed.
statement: 此外，饲喂冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼肠道表现出明显的病理变化，对饲料的消化和吸收产生负面影响。
text_zh: 此外，饲喂冷冻饲料和人工饲料的鱼肠道表现出明显的病理变化，对饲料的消化和吸收产生负面影响。
text_en: In addition, the intestines of fish fed frozen feed and artificial feed showed obvious pathological changes, negatively affecting the digestion and absorption of feed.

quote: Concurrent with tissue degradation is a reduction in the ability of the gut to process feeds.
statement: 伴随组织退化的是肠道处理饲料能力的降低。
text_zh: 伴随组织退化的是肠道处理饲料能力的降低。
text_en: Tissue degeneration is accompanied by a reduced ability of the gut to process feed.
intervention: Tissue degeneration from frozen and artificial feed
intervention_record: 冷冻和人工饲料导致的组织退化

quote: Although our research suggested that the most appropriate feed for hybrid mandarin fish is fresh bait fish, we found that hybrid mandarin fish can feed on frozen and artificial feed after acclimation.
statement: 虽然研究表明新鲜饵料鱼是杂交鳜鱼最合适的饲料，但发现经过驯化后杂交鳜鱼可以摄食冷冻和人工饲料。
text_zh: 虽然研究表明新鲜饵料鱼是杂交鳜鱼最合适的饲料，但发现经过驯化后杂交鳜鱼可以摄食冷冻和人工饲料。
text_en: Although studies show that fresh bait fish are the most suitable feed for hybrid mandarin fish, it was found that after acclimation, hybrid mandarin fish can consume frozen and artificial feeds.
counterevidence: 新鲜饵料鱼被认为是最合适的饲料

quote: The main reason why fish could not grow faster was that frozen and artificial feed decreased digestive enzymes activity and caused pathological changes of the alimentary canal.
statement: 鱼无法更快生长的主要原因是冷冻和人工饲料降低了消化酶活性并导致消化道病理变化。
text_zh: 鱼无法更快生长的主要原因是冷冻和人工饲料降低了消化酶活性并导致消化道病理变化。
text_en: The main reason fish cannot grow faster is that freezing and artificial feed reduce digestive enzyme activity and cause pathological changes in the digestive tract.
outcome: 生长性能、消化酶活性及消化道健康

quote: The lost of tissue structure, an evident pyknosis (nuclear destruction) and some necrosis and hemorrhagic tissue were also apparent in the liver of fish fed artificial feed.
statement: 投喂人工饲料的鱼的肝脏中可见组织结构丧失、明显的核固缩（核破坏）以及部分坏死和出血组织。
text_zh: 投喂人工饲料的鱼的肝脏中可见组织结构丧失、明显的核固缩（核破坏）以及部分坏死和出血组织。
text_en: Histological structure loss, marked pyknosis (nuclear destruction), and partial necrosis and hemorrhage were observed in the livers of fish fed artificial feed.

quote: The present study also revealed that the digestive enzymes activity, especially the protease of fish fed artificial feed, was significantly lower than in fish fed live and frozen feed.
statement: 本研究表明，投喂人工饲料的鱼的消化酶活性，特别是蛋白酶活性，显著低于投喂活饵和冷冻饲料的鱼。
text_zh: 本研究表明，投喂人工饲料的鱼的消化酶活性，特别是蛋白酶活性，显著低于投喂活饵和冷冻饲料的鱼。
text_en: This study shows that the digestive enzyme activity of fish fed artificial feed, particularly protease activity, is significantly lower than that of fish fed live bait and frozen feed.

quote: Many studies have shown that the relatively low level of enzyme activity was one of the reasons for limited success of diets and the poor growth of fish fed solely on artificial diets (Verreth et al., 1992; Day et al., 1997).
statement: 许多研究表明，相对较低的酶活性水平是仅投喂人工饲料导致饲料成功率有限和鱼类生长不良的原因之一。
text_zh: 许多研究表明，相对较低的酶活性水平是仅投喂人工饲料导致饲料成功率有限和鱼类生长不良的原因之一。
text_en: Many studies have shown that relatively low enzyme activity levels are one of the reasons why feeding only artificial feed leads to limited feed success and poor fish growth.

quote: Infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus
statement: 提及传染性脾肾坏死病毒。
text_zh: 提及传染性脾肾坏死病毒。
text_en: Mentioned infectious spleen and kidney necrosis virus.

quote:
However, these
substances are frequently omitted in formulated diets (Kolkovaski, 2001), and artificial
feeds sometimes contain proteins and other ingredients that are difficult for fish to digest
(Lindner et al., 1995), as well as other anti-nutritional factors.
statement: 人工饲料中常缺乏内源性消化酶，且可能含有难以消化的蛋白质及其他抗营养因子。
text_zh: 人工饲料中常缺乏内源性消化酶，且可能含有难以消化的蛋白质及其他抗营养因子。
text_en: Artificial feed often lacks endogenous digestive enzymes and may contain hard-to-digest proteins and other anti-nutritional factors.

quote:
In addition, observations
of feeding showed that when juveniles were offered fresh and frozen bait fish, they fed
by „visually locking on‟ to the feed and striking to consume it. However, when fed
artificial diets, they carefully scrutinised the feed before striking. Once the feed fell to the
bottom of the tank it was ignored by the juvenile mandarin fish.
statement: 观察发现，鳜鱼幼鱼摄食新鲜和冷冻饵料鱼时通过视觉锁定并攻击摄食；而摄食人工饲料时会仔细检查后才攻击，沉入缸底的饲料会被忽略。
text_zh: 观察发现，鳜鱼幼鱼摄食新鲜和冷冻饵料鱼时通过视觉锁定并攻击摄食；而摄食人工饲料时会仔细检查后才攻击，沉入缸底的饲料会被忽略。
text_en: Observations found that juvenile mandarin fish lock onto and attack to feed on fresh and frozen baitfish via vision; whereas when feeding on artificial feed, they inspect carefully before attacking, and feed sinking to the bottom of the tank is ignored.

quote:
In this study, the AST
activity was significantly higher in fish fed live and frozen feed compared to artificial feed,
indicating that fish responded to the bait fish positively.
statement: 本研究中，喂食活饵和冻饵的鱼AST活性显著高于喂食人工饲料的鱼，表明鱼对饵料鱼有积极反应。
text_zh: 本研究中，喂食活饵和冻饵的鱼AST活性显著高于喂食人工饲料的鱼，表明鱼对饵料鱼有积极反应。
text_en: In this study, the AST activity of fish fed live and frozen bait was significantly higher than that of fish fed artificial feed, indicating a positive response of fish to bait fish.

quote:
Hybrid Mandarin fish fed artificial feed had the lowest AST activity. This suggests that
protein metabolization was insufficient and did not increase amino acid levels in the liver,
which in turn activates this enzyme (Trenzado et al., 2006).
statement: 喂食人工饲料的杂交鳜鱼AST活性最低，这表明蛋白质代谢不足，未增加肝脏氨基酸水平从而激活该酶。
text_zh: 喂食人工饲料的杂交鳜鱼AST活性最低，这表明蛋白质代谢不足，未增加肝脏氨基酸水平从而激活该酶。
text_en: The AST activity of hybrid mandarin fish fed artificial feed was the lowest, indicating insufficient protein metabolism and that liver amino acid levels did not increase to activate this enzyme.
outcome: 蛋白质代谢与肝脏功能

quote: We detected the copies of SCRV RNA, ISKNV DNA, and LMBV DNA with TaqMan PCR methods.
statement: 使用TaqMan PCR方法检测SCRV RNA、ISKNV DNA和LMBV DNA的拷贝数。
text_en: 使用TaqMan PCR方法检测SCRV RNA、ISKNV DNA和LMBV DNA的拷贝数。

quote: Ninety mandarin fish (9 ± 1 cm) were divided into three groups (A, B, C). First, three fish of each group were taken out as the negative sample at 0 h; then the remaining fish in the A, B, and C groups were injected with SCRV (10 4 TCID50/fish), ISKNV (10 5 TCID50/fish), or LMBV (10 4 TCID50/fish), respectively.
statement: 将鳜鱼分为三组，分别注射SCRV、ISKNV或LMBV病毒以建立感染模型。
text_zh: 将鳜鱼分为三组，分别注射SCRV、ISKNV或LMBV病毒以建立感染模型。
text_en: Mandarin fish were divided into three groups and injected with SCRV, ISKNV, or LMBV virus to establish infection models.

quote: Diets were designed for three categories with different pregelatinized starch: 8% (NC), 13% (HC1), and 18% (HC2).
statement: 实验日粮设计为三种不同预糊化淀粉含量的类别：8%（NC）、13%（HC1）和18%（HC2）。
text_zh: 实验日粮设计为三种不同预糊化淀粉含量的类别：8%（NC）、13%（HC1）和18%（HC2）。
text_en: The experimental diets were designed with three categories of different pregelatinized starch contents: 8% (NC), 13% (HC1), and 18% (HC2).
intervention: Diets with different pregelatinized starch contents
intervention_record: 不同预糊化淀粉含量日粮

quote: This means that the carbohydrate utilization in carnivorous fish might be improved by environmental stresses, providing us a direction for further exploring the changes in glycometabolism under saline‐alkali or saline stresses, as well as the adaptation strategies centered around carbohydrates.
statement: 这意味着环境胁迫可能会提高肉食性鱼类对碳水化合物的利用，为探索盐碱或盐分胁迫下的糖代谢变化及以碳水化合物为中心的适应策略提供了方向。
text_zh: 这意味着环境胁迫可能会提高肉食性鱼类对碳水化合物的利用，为探索盐碱或盐分胁迫下的糖代谢变化及以碳水化合物为中心的适应策略提供了方向。
text_en: This means that environmental stress may increase the utilization of carbohydrates by carnivorous fish, providing a direction for exploring changes in sugar metabolism under saline-alkali or salinity stress and carbohydrate-centered adaptation strategies.

quote: It is essential to investigate the regulatory pathways of carbohydrate metabolism in S. chuatsi under saline‐alkali conditions, as well as to assess the effects of different dietary carbohydrate levels on its metabolic response, stress resistance, and growth performance.
statement: 有必要研究盐碱条件下鳜鱼碳水化合物代谢的调控途径，并评估不同日粮碳水化合物水平对其代谢反应、抗应激能力和生长性能的影响。
text_zh: 有必要研究盐碱条件下鳜鱼碳水化合物代谢的调控途径，并评估不同日粮碳水化合物水平对其代谢反应、抗应激能力和生长性能的影响。
text_en: It is necessary to study the regulatory pathways of carbohydrate metabolism in mandarin fish under saline-alkaline conditions, and to evaluate the effects of different dietary carbohydrate levels on their metabolic responses, stress resistance, and growth performance.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料
outcome: 代谢反应; 抗应激能力; 生长性能

quote: prolonged saline‐alkali stresses might bring adverse effects on fish growth, health, and even death
statement: 长期盐碱胁迫可能对鱼类的生长、健康甚至死亡产生不利影响。
text_zh: 长期盐碱胁迫可能对鱼类的生长、健康甚至死亡产生不利影响。
text_en: Long-term saline-alkali stress may adversely affect the growth, health, and even mortality of fish.

quote: In addition, the activities of the glycolysis pathway, pentose phosphate pathway, and gluconeogenesis pathway were enhanced prominently under this stress.
statement: 此外，在这种胁迫下，糖酵解途径、磷酸戊糖途径和糖异生途径的活性显著增强。
text_zh: 此外，在这种胁迫下，糖酵解途径、磷酸戊糖途径和糖异生途径的活性显著增强。
text_en: In addition, under this stress, the activities of the glycolysis pathway, the pentose phosphate pathway, and the gluconeogenesis pathway were significantly enhanced.

quote: However, the activities of amylase were inhibited with the increased carbohydrate intake, which impeded the process of glycometabolism.
statement: 然而，随着碳水化合物摄入量的增加，淀粉酶活性受到抑制，这阻碍了糖代谢过程。
text_zh: 然而，随着碳水化合物摄入量的增加，淀粉酶活性受到抑制，这阻碍了糖代谢过程。
text_en: However, as carbohydrate intake increases, amylase activity is inhibited, which hinders the sugar metabolism process.

quote: In contrast, the pentose phosphate pathway and gluconeogenesis pathway responded positively to dietary carbohydrate levels, especially under saline‐alkali stresses.
statement: 相比之下，磷酸戊糖途径和糖异生途径对膳食碳水化合物水平呈正反应，尤其是在盐碱胁迫下。
text_zh: 相比之下，磷酸戊糖途径和糖异生途径对膳食碳水化合物水平呈正反应，尤其是在盐碱胁迫下。
text_en: In contrast, the pentose phosphate pathway and gluconeogenesis pathway showed a positive response to dietary carbohydrate levels, especially under saline-alkali stress.

quote: Moreover, improving the carbohydrate level appropriately could significantly reduce the accumulation of malondialdehyde, promote the activities of superoxide dismutase, and total antioxidant capacity under saline‐alkali stress.
statement: 此外，适当提高碳水化合物水平可以显著减少盐碱胁迫下丙二醛的积累，促进超氧化物歧化酶活性和总抗氧化能力。
text_zh: 此外，适当提高碳水化合物水平可以显著减少盐碱胁迫下丙二醛的积累，促进超氧化物歧化酶活性和总抗氧化能力。
text_en: In addition, appropriately increasing the carbohydrate level can significantly reduce the accumulation of malondialdehyde under saline-alkali stress and promote superoxide dismutase activity and total antioxidant capacity.

quote: formulating a reasonable carbohydrate regulation strategy might be of great significance for promoting the adaptation capacity of fish under saline‐alkali stress
statement: 制定合理的碳水化合物调控策略可能对促进鱼类在盐碱胁迫下的适应能力具有重要意义。
text_zh: 制定合理的碳水化合物调控策略可能对促进鱼类在盐碱胁迫下的适应能力具有重要意义。
text_en: Developing reasonable carbohydrate regulation strategies may be of great significance for promoting the adaptive capacity of fish under saline-alkali stress.

quote: The death of fish only occurred in NC under saline‐alkali water, whose SR was 94.00 ± 6.00%. Nevertheless, there was no significant difference among the six groups (Figure 1 A).
statement: 仅在盐碱水条件下的NC组发生了鱼类死亡，存活率为94.00 ± 6.00%，但六组之间无显著差异。
text_zh: 仅在盐碱水条件下的NC组发生了鱼类死亡，存活率为94.00 ± 6.00%，但六组之间无显著差异。
text_en: Fish mortality occurred only in the NC group under saline-alkaline water conditions, with a survival rate of 94.00 ± 6.00%, but there was no significant difference among the six groups.

quote: Moreover, concentration of total ammonia nitrogen was required to be less than 0.5 mg/L, nitrites concentration less than 0.05 mg/L.
statement: 总氨氮浓度要求低于0.5 mg/L，亚硝酸盐浓度低于0.05 mg/L。
text_zh: 总氨氮浓度要求低于0.5 mg/L，亚硝酸盐浓度低于0.05 mg/L。
text_en: Total ammonia nitrogen concentration is required to be below 0.5 mg/L, and nitrite concentration below 0.05 mg/L.

quote: Additionally, during the 42 days culture experiment, 90% of the total volume of the water in each tank was replaced daily.
statement: 在42天的养殖实验中，每天更换每个水箱中90%的水量。
text_zh: 在42天的养殖实验中，每天更换每个水箱中90%的水量。
text_en: In a 42-day farming experiment, 90% of the water in each tank was replaced daily.

quote: Fish were starved for 24 h before sampling.
statement: 鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_zh: 鱼在采样前禁食24小时。
text_en: Fish were fasted for 24 hours before sampling.

quote: After anesthesia in a bath (20 mg/L MS‐222) for 60 s, fish were weighed and measured to determine growth performance [ 37 ].
statement: 鱼在20 mg/L的MS-222溶液中麻醉60秒后，进行称重和测量以确定生长性能。
text_zh: 鱼在20 mg/L的MS-222溶液中麻醉60秒后，进行称重和测量以确定生长性能。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized in a 20 mg/L MS-222 solution for 60 seconds, then weighed and measured to determine growth performance.

quote: However, prolonged saline‐alkali stress brought adverse effects on fish growth and healthy such as osmotic balance, ion toxicity, and oxidative stress, thereby impairing immune and death [ 7 – 12 ].
statement: 然而，长期的盐碱胁迫会对鱼类的生长和健康产生不利影响，如渗透平衡、离子毒性和氧化应激，从而损害免疫系统并导致死亡。
text_zh: 然而，长期的盐碱胁迫会对鱼类的生长和健康产生不利影响，如渗透平衡、离子毒性和氧化应激，从而损害免疫系统并导致死亡。
text_en: However, long-term saline-alkali stress can have adverse effects on the growth and health of fish, such as osmotic balance, ion toxicity, and oxidative stress, thereby impairing the immune system and leading to death.

quote: 450 juvenile mandarin fish (31.03 ± 0.12 g) with similar physical fitness were screened and randomly assigned to eighteen 500‐L round barrels with 25 fish in each barrel.
statement: 筛选出体格相似的幼鱼并随机分配到每个桶25尾的密度中。
text_zh: 筛选出体格相似的幼鱼并随机分配到每个桶25尾的密度中。
text_en: Juvenile fish of similar body size were selected and randomly assigned to each bucket at a density of 25 fish.

quote: fed for three different level of carbohydrate (8%, 13%, and 18%)
statement: 饲料中碳水化合物水平分为8%、13%和18%三个等级。
text_zh: 饲料中碳水化合物水平分为8%、13%和18%三个等级。
text_en: The carbohydrate levels in the feed were divided into three grades: 8%, 13%, and 18%.
intervention_record: 不同碳水化合物水平饲料

quote: fish were fed at 4% of their body weight at 16:00 per day.
statement: 每天下午4点按体重的4%投喂一次。
text_zh: 每天下午4点按体重的4%投喂一次。
text_en: Fed once daily at 4 PM at 4% of body weight.

quote: Throughout the trial, the temperature was controlled in 20 ± 1°C, and dissolved oxygen concentration ranged from 8.5 to 9.5 mg/L.
statement: 试验期间温度控制在20±1°C，溶解氧浓度维持在8.5至9.5 mg/L之间。
text_zh: 试验期间温度控制在20±1°C，溶解氧浓度维持在8.5至9.5 mg/L之间。
text_en: During the experimental period, the temperature was controlled at 20±1°C, and the dissolved oxygen concentration was maintained between 8.5 and 9.5 mg/L.

quote: Moreover, during high‐carbohydrate, gill lamellae and the external epithelial layer would become thicker and more swollen in fresh water.
statement: 在高碳水化合物条件下，淡水中的鳃小片和外部上皮层会变厚并更加肿胀。
text_zh: 在高碳水化合物条件下，淡水中的鳃小片和外部上皮层会变厚并更加肿胀。
text_en: Under high-carbohydrate conditions, the gill lamellae and external epithelial layer in freshwater become thicker and more swollen.

quote: In contrast, except possessing more chloride cells, the morphology of gills in SAW groups seemed to be becoming better then worse with the increase of carbohydrate (Figure 3 C).
statement: 在盐碱水（SAW）组中，除了拥有更多的氯细胞外，随着碳水化合物含量的增加，鳃的形态似乎先变好后变差。
text_zh: 在盐碱水（SAW）组中，除了拥有更多的氯细胞外，随着碳水化合物含量的增加，鳃的形态似乎先变好后变差。
text_en: In the saline-alkaline water (SAW) group, in addition to having more chloride cells, the morphology of the gills appeared to first improve and then worsen as carbohydrate content increased.

quote: Observation of kidney sections demonstrated similar consequences like cytoplasmic vacuolation aggravation and hypertrophy of glomeruli performed more swollen in saline‐alkali water (Figure 3 D).
statement: 肾脏切片观察显示，在盐碱水中，细胞质空泡化加重和肾小球肥大等后果表现得更为肿胀。
text_zh: 肾脏切片观察显示，在盐碱水中，细胞质空泡化加重和肾小球肥大等后果表现得更为肿胀。
text_en: Kidney slice observations showed that in saline-alkaline water, consequences such as aggravated cytoplasmic vacuolization and glomerular hypertrophy appeared more swollen.

quote: AMS in the intestine showed descendance with carbohydrate intake, particularly in SAW groups (Figure 4 A).
statement: 肠道中的淀粉酶活性随碳水化合物摄入量的增加而下降，特别是在盐碱水组中。
text_zh: 肠道中的淀粉酶活性随碳水化合物摄入量的增加而下降，特别是在盐碱水组中。
text_en: Amylase activity in the intestine decreases with increasing carbohydrate intake, especially in the saline-alkaline water group.

quote: Blood glucose in the HC1 group ascended significantly compared to NC group, but had not a further rise in HC2 group (Figure 4 B).
statement: 与对照组相比，HC1组的血糖显著升高，但在HC2组中没有进一步升高。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，HC1组的血糖显著升高，但在HC2组中没有进一步升高。
text_en: Compared with the control group, blood glucose levels increased significantly in the HC1 group, but did not increase further in the HC2 group.

quote: Besides, fish performed higher osmotic pressure when it fed with more carbohydrate or bred in saline‐alkali water, especially in comparison between NC groups and HC1groups (Figure 4 C).
statement: 当鱼摄入更多碳水化合物或在盐碱水中养殖时，其渗透压较高，特别是在NC组和HC1组的比较中。
text_zh: 当鱼摄入更多碳水化合物或在盐碱水中养殖时，其渗透压较高，特别是在NC组和HC1组的比较中。
text_en: When fish consume more carbohydrates or are farmed in saline-alkaline water, their osmotic pressure is higher, particularly in the comparison between the NC group and the HC1 group.
intervention_record: 盐碱水配合高碳水饲料

quote: Furthermore, fish had a better CF under saline‐alkali with the highest carbohydrate fed (Figure 1 D).
statement: 在盐碱水环境中并喂食最高水平碳水化合物的鱼具有更好的肥满度（CF）。
text_zh: 在盐碱水环境中并喂食最高水平碳水化合物的鱼具有更好的肥满度（CF）。
text_en: Fish in saline-alkaline water environments fed the highest level of carbohydrates had better condition factor (CF).
intervention_record: 盐碱水配合高碳水饲料

quote: Research indicated that a diet with more than 13% carbohydrate could lead to a significant accumulation of MDA in the liver from freshwater.
statement: 研究表明，在淡水中，超过13%碳水化合物的饮食会导致肝脏中MDA显著积累。
text_zh: 研究表明，在淡水中，超过13%碳水化合物的饮食会导致肝脏中MDA显著积累。
text_en: Studies show that in freshwater, diets with more than 13% carbohydrates lead to significant accumulation of MDA in the liver.

quote: However, in saline‐alkali water, there was no significant difference of MDA content between the SAW + HC1 group and the SAW + NC group, only a discrepancy in the SAW + HC2 group. (Figure 2 A).
statement: 在盐碱水中，SAW+HC1组与SAW+NC组的MDA含量无显著差异，仅在SAW+HC2组存在差异。
text_zh: 在盐碱水中，SAW+HC1组与SAW+NC组的MDA含量无显著差异，仅在SAW+HC2组存在差异。
text_en: In saline-alkaline water, there was no significant difference in MDA content between the SAW+HC1 group and the SAW+NC group; a difference existed only in the SAW+HC2 group.
intervention_record: 盐碱水配合高碳水饲料

quote: SOD activities didn’t display significant differences in FW groups, whereas it demonstrated ascendance in the HC1 group and decline in the HC2 group from SAW groups
statement: 在淡水（FW）组中SOD活性无显著差异；而在咸淡水（SAW）组中，HC1组的SOD活性升高，HC2组的SOD活性下降。
text_zh: 在淡水（FW）组中SOD活性无显著差异；而在咸淡水（SAW）组中，HC1组的SOD活性升高，HC2组的SOD活性下降。
text_en: In the freshwater (FW) group, there was no significant difference in SOD activity; whereas in the brackish water (SAW) group, SOD activity increased in the HC1 group and decreased in the HC2 group.
